title: 邻里的项链针
cn: 邻里的姨母丢失项链，外甥脖子留下针痕，侄女紧张得说不出话。林澈没有把阴性检测结果当成无需再查的理由。
必要的谈判让邻居停止责备，忽视微小证据却可能造成损失。旧记录用带歧视的过时词语登记一位居民，不能以偏见判断其可信度。
林澈整理两种拼写的社区档案，找到相邻房屋中的项链。他点明神经病症而非胆小造成颤抖，邻居们终于理解受害者。
en: An aunt’s [[necklace]] vanished. Her [[nephew]] had a [[needle]] mark on his [[neck]], while her [[niece]] seemed [[nervous]]. A [[negative]] test did not [[necessarily]] end the inquiry. Further evidence could [[necessitate]] another visit.

[[negotiation|Negotiation]] was a [[necessity]], not a chance for blame. To [[neglect]] even [[negligible]] signs could cost a life. An old record used [[negro|“Negro”]], an obsolete, offensive label that could not decide a witness’s credibility.

Lin compared the [[neighborhood]] and [[neighbourhood]] files, then found the jewel in a [[neighbouring]] house. A [[neighbour]] explained her [[nerve]] disorder. Their [[needless]] accusations ended when the girl was treated and the thief confessed.

title: 鸟巢网络的噩梦
cn: 新建网络站旁鸟巢突然空了，十九名学生陷入噩梦般恐慌。报摊上的绰号纸条指向一个吵闹怪人，他只点头不答。修理工发现巢台被松动电线组成的网缠住。
神经元模型与中子仪器其实未检测出任何危险。镍片与氮气记录均正常，所测伤害为零。
林澈保持中立，仍提名无名修理工接受表彰。所谓高贵头衔只是名义，人们终于不再听信无稽之谈，鸟巢也恢复安静。

A [[noble]] title was only [[nominal]]. He chose to [[nominate]] the unknown repairer who restored the nesting platform. [[nonetheless|Nonetheless]], some repeated [[nonsense]] until the birds returned. Quiet evidence finally convinced the students.

title: 北行通知与零的符号
cn: 北方站点发出通知，称著名学者的笔记藏着恶名盗贼线索。列车向东北开去，林澈却注意到地图向西北的箭头。
正常化记录要先统一符号。显著的差异不代表阴谋，零被写作另一符号，名词标注也只是课堂习惯。
尽管传闻不断，林澈通知旅客并公开解释。北行与向北的两种说法相同，正规的检查使错误观念消失，普通列车照常运行。

A [[notable]] difference in [[notation]] did not prove crime. [[normalization|Normalization]] required the same [[norm]]: [[nought]] meant zero, while a [[noun]] label belonged to an ordinary lesson. The supposed code was [[normal]].

Lin would [[notify]] everyone and explain the mistaken [[notion]]. [[notwithstanding|Notwithstanding]] rumors, the train ran [[normally]]. Clear records, rather than an exciting accusation, brought the travelers home.

title: 修女的苗圃小说
cn: 修女养育苗圃里的孩子，也写新奇小说。如今有人称儿童营养来自核能奇迹，竟把纸上科学当成真实食物。
云岚用数值实验发现尼龙袋中的果仁缺乏必要营养。许多捐赠者只顾追求新奇，找不到实际采购记录。
她解释细胞核与核装置的区别，给孩子真正滋养。滋养需要营养物质和照料而非噱头，烦人的谣言终于止息。

A [[numerical]] test showed that each [[nut]] in a [[nylon]] bag lacked an essential [[nutrient]]. [[numerous|Numerous]] donations bought slogans instead of sound [[nutrition]].

Yun explained that a cell’s [[nucleus]] was not a reactor. Real care would [[nourish]] the children; real [[nourishment]] required food. The false claim ceased to be a [[nuisance]], and the nursery reopened with honest supplies.

title: 橡树下的誓言
cn: 药堂学徒在橡树下宣誓服从师命，肥胖病人却反对粗暴疗法。守旧医师把异议当不服从，逼弟子放弃观察。
云岚取得旁观者记录，说明肥胖需要照料，不是道德缺陷。医师痴迷权威，甚至拿粗俗玩笑侮辱病人。
障碍看似明显，解除却要勇气。学徒不再固执，拿桨划船送病者就诊；帮助他人是义务，不能强迫病者顺从。

Yun would [[obtain]] an [[observer]]’s [[observation]]. [[obesity|Obesity]] needed care, not blame. She chose to [[observe]] the doctor’s [[obsession]] with control and challenge his [[obscene]] joke. The patient had a right to [[object]].

The [[obstacle]] was [[obvious]], but courage was needed. [[obviously|Obviously]], an [[obstinate]] teacher could still be wrong. The apprentice took an [[oar]] and carried the patient to safety. Duty was an [[obligation]] to help, not a demand to [[oblige]] people to submit.

title: 海洋洲来的气味
cn: 来自大洋洲的访客偶尔住进旅馆。他的职业是测海洋气味，却被指控偶然出现的恶臭是他制造。
官方人员调查两种拼写的投诉，发现对商人而言不同拼写只是冒犯理由。橄榄油瓶里藏着测电阻仪器，造成小孩疑惑。
林澈提供公平检测。一台以欧姆测电阻的仪器放在橄榄油旁，不会伤害任何人的后代；测试消除流言，隐蔽排污口才是恶臭来源。
en: On one [[occasion]], a traveler from [[oceania|Oceania]] came to [[occupy]] a room. His [[occupation]] was testing [[ocean]] water. [[occasional|Occasional]] smells would [[occur]] nearby; he [[occasionally]] reported each [[occurrence]].

An [[officer]] read an [[official]] complaint about an [[odd]] [[odor]], spelled [[odour]] on another form. The merchant called it an [[offence]], or [[offense]], and used [[offensive]] words to [[offend]] the visitor.

Lin’s [[offer]] was a fair test. A device measuring resistance in [[ohm|ohms]] lay beside [[olive]] [[oil]]; it could not harm anyone’s [[offspring]]. The findings would [[offset]] the rumor. A hidden waste outlet, not the traveler, caused the smell.

cn: 歌剧院持续的行动缺少透明记录，操作员被说与对手合谋。林澈审问门对面的人，不想因个人意见压迫员工。

cn: 果园举办音乐会，选读诗歌可自愿，口头排练却忽然变成争执。普通乐手与风琴师被要求尊重共同安排。

孤儿做的装饰品被当成无用，却藏着新旋律。植物与矿石课让众人理解原生材料，乐团接受新手，保守观念也逐渐松动。

杰出裁缝为居民做衣服，却被勒令在外面等候。众人的愤怒来自无端排斥，向外的迁移不是袭击。
从一开始，云岚就要求公正结果。她带足一盎司药粉，告诉守卫该提供帮助，否则疫情会扩大；营地重新获准求医。

cn: 面包房椭圆烤炉溢出烟气，过期检查被一件大衣遮住。林澈克服惊慌，听见房梁上的密谈。
有人高估炉容量，给电路过载；窗沿悬垂的板子与天花线路重叠。海外来的修理者加班整夜，才发现天桥过后藏着坏配件。
公开维修后，坏老板的谎言被推翻。旧检查本来遗漏关键问题，如今街道的人追上失控推车、扶正它，压倒性的证据保护了工人。

臭氧警报是漏气导致。双方补上软垫，用水桶收集漏液，指出疼痛源于误触；船主承认欠款，工人得到补偿。

真正黑豹来自画而非野兽。众人在棕榈树下吃饼，画家承认把娱乐宣传做成了惊吓，给恐慌的伙伴赔礼。

云岚逐段检查路线，发现平行通道只打开一部分。参数显示礼物包裹带着寄生虫，一种虫可能造成麻痹。
议会调查一位偏袒主办方的负责人。参与者获救，悖论终于解释：越盲目参加越危险。云岚将污染颗粒清除，使节庆回归真实欢乐。

山峰下的梨树与珍珠摊本该安宁，商人却说野兽有奇异习性，阻止行人与小贩通行。林澈踩下车踏板，追到木桩前。
他剥开木桩漆层，窥见藏着的收费簿。与同行比对后，和平的集市恢复，老板为假兽收钱受到处罚。

云岚让演员继续表演，却公开每人的收益比例。或许表演能完美，账目仍需透明；透明规则减少欺骗造成的险境。

title: 周刊上的永久许可证
cn: 周刊刊出永久开采许可，却没有边界测量。定期检查发现外围矿洞正渗入水，工人可能丧命。
云岚立起垂直标杆测周长。许可只在特定时期有效，所谓永远免检是误读；气味也渗透到居民井水。
负责人声称任何操作都获允许，却不能说明文件真伪。巡使公开许可范围，矿井永久停用危险区，边缘村庄终于安全。
en: A [[periodical]] announced a [[permanent]] mine [[permit]], but no survey marked its [[perimeter]]. A [[periodic]] check found water in a [[peripheral]] shaft, where workers could [[perish]].
Yun set a [[perpendicular]] post to measure the boundary. The license covered one [[period]], not an eternal exemption. A smell would [[permeate]] village wells while the owner delayed repairs.
He claimed every action was [[permissible]]. Yun published the real limits and closed the dangerous shaft [[permanently]]. A clear record brought more safety than a reassuring headline.

title: 永动钟的执念
cn: 永动钟让居民困惑，负责人不断迫害提出问题的人。云岚流汗检查钟室，从个人性格猜测退回物证。
悲观员工仍坚持工作，执著请求停止虐待。他们请愿书的相关内容被忽略，管理者用巧言劝人别再追问。
从工人的视角，所谓永恒只是被迫持续加班。云岚用有说服力证据说服人们支持，恶劣工作环境得到改善，个人尊严被保护。
en: A [[perpetual]] clock would [[perplex]] residents. Its owner chose to [[persecute]] anyone who questioned it. Yun wiped away [[perspiration]] and stopped judging truth by [[personal]] charm or [[personality]].

[[pessimistic|Pessimistic]] [[personnel]] still had to [[persevere]]. A [[persistent]] worker would [[persist]] with a [[petition]]; his [[persistence]] deserved attention. Its [[pertinent]] details exposed the owner’s smooth [[persuasion]].

From the workers’ [[perspective]], endless magic meant endless unpaid shifts. Yun’s [[persuasive]] evidence could [[persuade]] neighbors to help. The clock stopped, and the exhausted workers finally rested.

cn: 慈善家办摄影展募款救动物，哲学家却指出展览以害虫与宠物价差宣传，会使小额捐赠者被轻视。
一通电话叫来物理学家与医师。光电设备造成假照片，摄影师承认石油与汽油烟雾让被摄者出现身体反应。
医师解释生理变化，不是神秘超能力。慈善展调整阶段目标，结束琐碎争执；真正的慈善理念需保护拍摄者与动物。

A [[phrase]] about miraculous strength misread the subject’s [[physical]] reaction. He was [[physically]] affected by smoke; the change was [[physiological]]. The exhibit entered a safer [[phase]], protecting animals and people instead of selling false wonder.

cn: 码头野餐上，馅饼与腌菜被人下毒。鸽子落在柱旁，猪也在食物堆边停步，药师看见一根针刺穿盒盖。
巡礼者头枕枕头，服药丸后发晕。飞行员摘下胸针，用小夹子取出毒针；松树下粉色饮料也要检查。
一品脱菠萝汁里藏着异常成分。云岚让虔诚信徒别拒绝医治，宗门护卫查清出入记录，野餐者全部得救。

A [[pilgrim]] rested on a [[pillow]], dizzy after one [[pill]]. A [[pilot]] removed a [[pin]] from his coat and used it to lift the needle with a careful [[pinch]]. Under a [[pine]], a [[pink]] drink waited untouched.

One [[pint]] of [[pineapple]] juice held the same chemical. The [[pious]] traveler accepted treatment while guards checked who had approached the table. Everyone survived, and the hidden supplier faced the evidence.

她检查管中沥青，阻止继续抽水。瘟疫需治而非神迹，工人安全修好管道，海盗所谓拯救者身份被揭穿。

cn: 操场球员向富豪求情，请求停止掠夺农地。肥胖地主给出愉快承诺，随后却让工人潜入仓库抢粮。
云岚拔下气动泵插头，发现犁地用水被偷。充足粮食不意味着可以任意拿走，阴谋在复数收据中出现。
她提出多元制度让居民共同决定。加上真正还款，富豪的保证才有效；村民有了足够粮食，孩子再度回到操场。

Yun pulled a [[plug]] from the [[pneumatic]] pump. Water for fields worked with a [[plough]] had been diverted. [[plentiful|Plentiful]] grain did not justify theft. A [[plural]] set of receipts exposed the [[plot]]; one worker tried to [[pluck]] them away.

A rule of [[pluralism]], [[plus]] actual repayment, made the pledge meaningful. There was [[plenty]] for everyone. Children returned to play, and villagers finally controlled the water their fields needed.

title: 诗人的极性指控
cn: 诗人把毒药警告写在诗里，放进口袋。他指着杆上极性标记，说极地实验用的有毒材料被政治人物偷去。
警方不凭诗歌裁决，巡使轻戳包装，发现聚合物壳内污染物。有人为让商品受欢迎，宣传其能消除污染。
民意调查使政策改变。林澈擦亮标签，证明污染来自港池，民众不再只听政治口号；诗仍流行，重要的是其中证据可核验。

cn: 港口给搬运工提供粥，却有人把份额偷偷扣走。门廊上的瓷碗旁，一幅肖像描绘葡萄牙厨师，试图让大家怀疑他。
便携机器统计港口人口与捐赠者人气，微小毛孔般的小孔却漏出水。池塘旁气泡啪地破裂，暴露隐藏排水管。
林澈沉思后要求实际位置测量，厨师以积极态度配合。人们终于确知肖像姿势只是照相姿态，扣粮者被查明，工人领回食物。

title: 邮差与未来的锅
cn: 邮差把邮票、海报和一口锅送到学堂。老师说不能仅因拥有东西就证明所有权，未来存在可能，也不代表已成事实。
邮政检查发现家禽被关在包裹里。学生试图用姿态与传闻推断老师行骗，老师却让他们先提出可检验的假设。
活动被延期，鸡群回到原主，锅也物归其主。教宗捐赠函经核实不是赝品，未来的潜力应在关照生命中兑现。

They chose to [[postpone]] the show and return the birds. The letter proved genuine, and the pot went to its owner. Real [[potential]] began with caring for living things rather than making grand predictions.

title: 荒原上的祈雨钟
cn: 寒冬使草原村庄陷入贫困。年轻僧人捣碎树根，把粉末倒入干井，试图唤醒祈雨钟的力量。
前任留下了精确的仪式步骤。长老要求他先练动作、再念祷词，却没有宣称苦难命中注定。
风暴到来后，他把铜钟移上山丘引走雷电，防止村里起火。雨终于落在田间，村民围着古井向他致谢。
en: The [[preceding]] winter had brought [[poverty]] to the [[prairie]]. A young monk would [[pound]] roots into [[powder]] and [[pour]] them into a dry well. He hoped its hidden [[power]] was still [[powerful]] enough to summon rain.

His [[predecessor]] had left a [[preface]] to the ritual: [[practise]] the movements with [[precision]], and let a [[precise]] [[prayer]] [[precede]] every strike. The method seemed [[practicable]], though [[practical]] farmers had [[practically]] abandoned hope. The elder refused to [[preach]] that suffering was [[predestine|predestined]].

A [[predictable]] storm appeared, but the monk rejected the [[prediction]] that lightning must destroy the village. Copper was the [[predominant]] metal in the bell; it would [[predominate]] in the alloy used to rebuild its damaged rim. He moved the [[precious]] bell to a hill to [[preclude]] injury and avoided actions that might [[precipitate]] a fire. Rain fell [[predominantly]] on the fields. There was no [[precedent]] for his rescue, yet the villagers gathered to [[praise]] him and [[pray]] beside the well.

cn: 林药师受命照看一位怀孕的证人。官员因偏见，把证人的警告当成过早的判断。她先安排安静房间，取得对方信任。
一位来客试图开出会抹去记忆的药，费用异常高。林发现案情建立在错误前提上，便重新准备问询。
药瓶上一个介词被改动，服药时间也随之改变。她当着证人的面展示证据并封存药瓶，证人终于想起来客的脸。
en: Lin would [[prefer]] a quiet clinic, but the [[premier]] sent her to a [[pregnant]] witness. The woman’s [[pregnancy]] had become an excuse for [[prejudice]]: officials dismissed her warning as a [[premature]] judgment. Lin found that a private room was [[preferable]], regardless of the court’s [[preference]].

A [[preparatory]] meeting revealed the false [[premise]] behind the case. Trust was a [[prerequisite]] for testimony, so Lin began her [[preparation]] by asking permission to [[prepare]] tea. A strangely [[prescient]] visitor tried to [[prescribe]] sleeping medicine; his [[prescription]] named a herb that erased memory. The [[premium]] paid for it was suspiciously high.

In the witness’s [[presence]], Lin gave a clear [[presentation]] of the bottle labels. A tiny [[preposition]] changed “before birth” to “after birth”; the doctor had altered the instructions. Lin would [[presently]] inform the magistrate. For the [[preservation]] of evidence, she locked the bottle in a case with a [[preset]] seal. The witness remembered the visitor’s face.

cn: 总统任期将尽，严法官主持了一场备受媒体关注的审讯。所有人都催他给守卫一个体面的结论。

en: The [[president]] asked Judge Yan to [[preside]] over a hearing during the final month of his [[presidency]]. The [[press]] expected a display of [[prestige]], and [[pressure]] mounted. Yan was [[presumably]] supposed to [[presume]] the guard innocent.

The guard tried to [[pretend]] that a [[pretty]] [[preview]] leaflet was the [[previous]] visitor’s property. His [[pretext]] could not [[prevail]]: the [[prevailing]] ink was blue, while this page was red. Theft was [[prevalent]], but its [[prevalence]] did not excuse forged evidence. A [[preventive]] inspection might [[prevent]] another victim from becoming his [[prey]]; [[prevention]] now came first.

Yan felt a [[prick]] of [[pride]] when a [[priest]] translated the writing. It was [[primarily]] a [[primary]] school exercise about a [[primate]], not a plot against the [[prince]] or [[princess]]. The [[prime]] clue lay in the [[primitive]] [[printer]]: its [[principal]] flaw was a missing letter. Yan would [[print]] a test and act [[principally]] on the [[principle]] of verifiable proof. Nobody had noticed that flaw [[previously]].

title: 棱镜后的逃生路
cn: 囚徒用棱镜检查监狱窗户，找到了旧调查提过的通道。典狱长只顾私隐，唯独允许一名私人访客进入。
他们计划趁葬礼队伍经过时逃走。访客是一位溶剂生产者，用长期实验制得的安全药液缓慢处理门锁。
囚徒曾教授光学，凭耐心和专业知识避开机关。两人成功脱身，访客拒绝把营救当成牟利的广告。
en: The [[prisoner]] held a [[prism]] toward the [[prison]] window. A [[prior]] [[probe]] had found a passage there, but the warden gave [[priority]] to his own [[privacy]]. Only a [[private]] visitor enjoyed the [[privilege]] of entering; the promised [[prize]] for rescue remained unpaid.

The [[probability]] of escape seemed low. A [[probable]] ally would [[probably]] arrive during the funeral [[procession]]. To [[proceed]], they first studied the [[proceeding|proceedings]] of the old trial. The lock’s [[processing]] mechanism used a slow chemical [[process]]. The visitor was a [[producer]] who could [[produce]] a safe solvent, a [[product]] of years of [[production]] trials.

The prisoner, once a [[professor]], did not [[profess]] magical knowledge. His [[profession]] required [[professional]] patience, and he was [[proficient]] in lenses. His [[proficiency]] made the workshop [[productive]] without risking its workers; higher [[productivity]] had never justified the jailer’s [[profit]]. The visitor erased his public [[profile]], dissolved the lock, and refused a [[profitable]] contract to [[proclaim]] the escape as an advertisement.

title: 被禁止的飞舟
cn: 年轻工程师试造飞舟，却因投影中的桅杆阴影被禁止测试。禁令将使山村继续与外界隔绝。
权臣要她交出设计，才肯批准。他遭到拒绝后散布流言，船员也开始害怕。工程师让大家练清晰的指令，以免误会酿祸。
她公开展示了螺旋桨和冷却系统。飞舟安全落地，山谷中的人们开始依据实证判断传闻。
en: A [[progressive]] engineer presented a [[promising]] [[project]] to the council. Its [[program]] recorded steady [[progress]], but a [[projecting]] spar caught the [[projector]] beam. Officials used that shadow to [[prohibit]] trials; the [[prohibition]] would [[prolong]] the village’s isolation.

A [[prominent]] minister used his [[prominence]] to [[promote]] a rival’s [[promotion]]. He made a [[promise]] of [[prompt]] approval if the engineer surrendered her design. She [[promptly]] refused. The crew were [[prone]] to panic, so she taught them to [[pronounce]] commands with clear [[pronunciation]]. One ambiguous [[pronoun]] could send a sailor overboard.

The minister’s [[propaganda]] claimed the craft would explode. Its [[propeller]] could safely [[propel]] the hull, and the [[propulsion]] system cooled [[properly]] in flight. The engineer offered [[proof]] through a [[proper]] demonstration. News would [[propagate]] along the valley, but she asked people to check it before further [[propagation]]. The council watched the craft land unharmed.

title: 预言家的份额
cn: 预言家向全省许诺丰收，却要求缴纳不成比例的粮税。账册写满繁荣果园的故事，真正的树木却停止生长。
守卫以保护实验室为名遮掩空药瓶。预言家说罕见蛋白能让树枝伸向天际，仍拿不出成果。
园丁从死树根部找到偷水的暗渠，拒绝对方挑衅。她造出水泵恢复灌溉，村民保留证据，请官府追诉骗局。
en: A [[prophet]] sold a [[prophecy]] that promised [[prosperity]] to the [[province]]. His [[proposal]] required a huge [[proportion]] of every harvest; the tax was hardly [[proportional]] to anyone’s income. He would [[propose]] the same [[proposition]] to each [[prospective]] donor.

A clerk wrote [[prose]] describing a [[prosperous]] orchard with no [[prospect]] of drought. Yet the trees had stopped growing. The prophet claimed that their branches would [[protend]] toward the sky if fed a rare [[protein]]. Guards in [[protective]] robes tried to [[protect]] his laboratory, but their [[protection]] concealed empty bottles.

The university [[provost]] asked a [[prudent]] gardener to [[prune]] one dead tree. Roots revealed a drain, whose [[proximity]] to the river explained the stolen water. The gardener refused a [[provocative]] challenge; such [[provocation]] merely distracted the crowd. A stolen [[proton]] gauge violated the academy’s [[protocol]]. The gardener built a [[prototype]] pump to [[provide]] water, [[provided]] the village funded its [[provision]]. She was [[proud]] to [[prove]] the old [[proverb]] about patient work. The magistrate would [[prosecute]] the prophet after the villagers’ [[protest]], [[providing]] they preserved the drain as evidence.

title: 木偶师的脉搏
cn: 精神科医生要求记者暂缓公布失踪儿童细节，以免惊动绑匪。集市上布丁和南瓜摊仍热闹，木偶戏却迟迟没有开演。
后台的滑轮与水泵遮住一名被下药的男孩。他穿着紫色睡衣，脉搏微弱，购食记录成为重要线索。
医生先过滤净水，再用清水唤醒孩子。遗落的钱包揭示了绑架目的和购买地点，孩子获救后，法院独立完成了惩处。
en: A [[psychiatrist]] studying [[psychology]] arrived before the [[public]] [[publication]] of a missing-child report. Its [[publicity]] could endanger the child, so the reporter agreed to [[publish]] only after a rescue. At the fair, a boy ate [[pudding]] beside a carved [[pumpkin]], while a [[puppy]] chased a [[puff]] of steam.

The [[punctual]] [[puppet]] performance failed. Behind the stage, the doctor found a [[pulley]], a [[pump]], and a glove designed to [[punch]] holes in tickets. The missing boy’s [[pulse]] was faint beneath his [[purple]] [[pyjamas]]. Someone had drugged him after a [[purchase]] at the food stall.

The doctor used a filter to [[purify]] water, then rinsed the boy’s face with the [[pure]] liquid, acting [[purely]] to wake him. Tests later checked the drink’s [[purity]]. A dropped [[purse]] disclosed the kidnapper’s [[purpose]]; its receipt solved the [[puzzle]]. The boy recovered, and the court decided to [[punish]] the culprit without making the child watch the [[punishment]].

title: 女王的石英量杯
cn: 女王征集净水方案。学徒提出定量检测，不肯仅凭外观判断水质，报名者还须证明资格。
一名商人围绕石英量杯争吵，报价却远超自身季度配额。他无法指出合法依据，村民的问卷则记录了缺水情况。
队伍中的人越来越焦躁。女王在问询中发现商人手抖，检查其暗藏水箱，追回了足以解渴的泉水。
en: A [[queen]] held a [[quest]] for clean water. Each applicant needed a [[qualification]] to [[qualify]], but [[qualitative]] impressions alone could not establish water [[quality]]. An apprentice asked to [[quantify]] the impurity with [[quantitative]] tests of each [[quantity]].

A [[queer]] merchant began a [[quarrel]] over a [[quart]] measure made of [[quartz]]. His [[quarterly]] [[quota]] permitted only ten deliveries, yet his [[quotation]] offered a hundred. The queen asked him to [[quote]] the regulation. His answer was [[questionable]], unlike the villagers’ honest [[questionnaire]] responses.

A long [[queue]] formed as thirst began to [[quicken]] tempers. The apprentice wrapped a shivering child in a [[quilt]], then watched the merchant’s hands [[quiver]] during a short [[quiz]]. He threatened to [[quit]], but the queen opened his hidden tank. The recovered spring water could finally [[quench]] the village’s thirst.

title: 镭矿列车
cn: 山地列车赛途中，货架发出异响。守卫带着族群偏见责怪乘客，周探员阻止了粗暴搜查，转而检查货车。
雷达出现放射状信号，发光表盘揭露一箱放射性镭。散热器遭拆除，矿箱正逼近炉火。
周用湿布和耙子移开藏在萝卜、葡萄干之间的矿箱。封印指向矿主，嫌疑乘客获释，雨林归途出现彩虹。
en: A [[rabbit]] crossed the [[rail]] during a mountain [[race]]. The driver heard a [[racket]] from the luggage [[rack]]. Station guards wrongly blamed a passenger through [[racial]] [[rage]], until Detective Zhou ordered a careful [[raid]] on the freight car instead.

The [[railway]] [[radar]] showed a [[radial]] signal around one crate. A [[radiant]] dial began to [[radiate]] light; its [[radiation]] came from [[radioactive]] [[radium]]. Tests of [[radioactivity]] measured the dangerous [[radius]]. The [[radiator]] had been removed, a [[radical]] alteration that threatened the entire [[railroad]].

Zhou used a wet [[rag]] and a [[rake]] to move the crate away from the stove. Hidden among [[radish|radishes]] and a bag of [[raisin|raisins]], it bore the mine owner’s seal. During the [[rainy]] return through the [[rainforest]], a [[rainbow]] appeared above the bridge. The passenger was cleared, and the mine’s sabotage case began.

title: 牧场的第二声敲击
cn: 牧场主人散步后失踪。卢探员根据守夜人提过的敲击声安排搜索，而没有让大家随意散开。
第二声响来自坏掉的捕鼠器。流氓对工人的严重诬告也被证词推翻，卢坚持逐项核实。
地板下的一束光暴露了囚禁地点。绳结越收越紧，她用剃刀割断绳索救人。账册的销售比例进一步证明守夜人盗卖牲畜，牧场主人重见天日。
en: A [[rally]] brought workers to a [[ranch]] where the owner had disappeared during a [[ramble]]. Detective Lu rejected a [[random]] search across the whole [[range]]. She assigned each rider a [[rank]] and listened for the [[rap]] described by the night guard.

The first knock was followed by a [[rapid]] [[rattle]]. Its [[rapidity]] matched a broken [[rat]] trap, not footsteps. Lu [[rapidly]] checked the shed. A [[rascal]] had made a [[rash]] accusation of [[rape]] against a worker, but the victim’s [[rare]] testimony showed that the accusation was false. Lu would [[rarely]] accept a tale without corroboration.

A [[rational]] inspection of [[raw]] timber disclosed a [[ray]] of light under the floor. A discarded [[razor]] lay near the captive owner. A knot tightened at an alarming [[rate]]; Lu cut his bonds, [[rather]] than forcing a locked door. The town’s [[rating]] of the guard fell when accounts exposed his stolen cattle; the [[ratio]] of recorded sales to real animals had betrayed him. cn: 读旧案卷的女文书赶到废弃税所。税吏不肯承认免税约定，甚至否认反应炉泄漏产生的烟雾。
她重新评估风险，在办公室后部发现倒写的收据。正确阅读日期就能证明农民早已缴款，官方说法与现实不符。
退休收款员证实了日期。税吏试图煽动骚乱掩盖欺诈，文书当面斥责并追回应收账款，村民得以修复炉墙、重新收获。

A [[realistic]] reassessment was needed. The clerk would [[reassess]] the danger and [[reassure]] the farmers, whose [[reality]] differed from official reports. At the office’s [[rear]], she came to a [[realization]]: the collector had reversed every [[receipt]]. A [[reasonable]] judge would [[realize]] that the farmers had paid already.

A retired [[receiver]] could [[readily]] confirm the dates. The collector threatened to [[rebel]], hoping a [[rebellion]] would hide the fraud. The clerk gave a firm [[rebuke]], asked him to [[recall]] the original accounts, and watched his bravado [[recede]]. The money helped [[rebuild]] the reactor’s wall, and farmers could again [[reap]] their crops.

cn: 经济衰退后，休闲大厅突然恢复开放。组织者送蛋糕配方、请客人朗诵，借互惠姿态吸引新人。
新人发现长方形盒中的录音机在窃取秘密。她记下序列号，找到被盗货物记录。
组织者求和，但受害者先追索损失。秘密录音在庭上证明了威胁，旧磁带被回收，防止同样的勒索再次发生。

The [[recruitment]] was a [[reckless]] scheme. A [[recorder]] inside a [[rectangular]] box kept a [[record]] of visitors’ secrets. The recruit drew a [[rectangle]] around the suspicious device and asked a friend to [[recognize]] its maker. [[recognition|Recognition]] of its serial number led to a stolen shipment.

The organizer sought [[reconciliation]], but the recruit would [[reckon]] the losses first. She could [[recommend]] a fair settlement without accepting a false [[recommendation]]. The victims would [[reclaim]] their money and [[reconcile]] only after its [[recovery]]. To prevent the crime from starting to [[recur]], they would [[recycle]] the recording tapes; the final [[recurrence]] of a recorded threat became courtroom evidence.

title: 芦苇里的避难者
cn: 难民藏在礁石旁的芦苇中，带着炼厂排污的胶片。市长想用退船票钱平息愤怒。
河上比赛的裁判给他提供避难所。难民留下拼写特殊的纸条，引导她从镜后取出备份胶片。
胶片使市长的否认站不住脚。裁判制止报复性纵火，照顾证人，并促使议会整治排污管道。
en: A [[refugee]] hid among [[reed|reeds]] near a [[reef]]. He carried a film [[reel]] showing a [[refinery]] dumping waste. The mayor offered a [[refund]] for his boat ticket, hoping to [[reduce]] public anger to a minor financial [[reduction]].

A [[referee]] of the river games provided [[refuge]]. She refused to [[refer]] the refugee back to officials without a trustworthy [[reference]]. The pollution would [[reflect]] a failure to [[refine]] the waste. A note using the older spelling “[[reflexion]]” named a mirror where he had hidden a second reel.

The mayor’s [[refusal]] to investigate could not [[refute]] the film. He tried to [[refuse]] all questions [[regarding]] the pipes. [[regardless|Regardless]] of his threats, the referee demanded [[reform]], asking fishers to [[refrain]] from burning the office. They shared [[refreshment]] from a small [[refrigerator]] to [[refresh]] the exhausted witness. The council agreed to remove [[redundant]] drains and treat the river with proper [[regard]].

title: 旧王朝的绿色名单
cn: 旧军团按册夺地，新女王却想通过植树让烧毁的森林再生。官员仍习惯规律收税，对昔日损失毫无悔意。
加冕排练时，信使送来旧规章，要求继续控制议会。女王公开拒绝，军官试图用士兵施压。
她公布被藏起的受害名单，命令赔偿，并调任指挥官做文书。村民庆祝重获土地，指挥官则必须核对每次征地的归属。

At a [[rehearsal]] for her coronation, a messenger seized the horse’s [[rein]]. He carried orders to [[regulate]] the council by an obsolete [[regulation]]. The queen would [[reject]] that order; her [[rejection]] made the soldiers uneasy. Their commander tried to [[reinforce]] his demand for [[regular]] taxes paid [[regularly]].

The queen read the hidden list aloud. Villagers would be [[reimburse|reimbursed]] for lost fields, and the commander would be [[relegate|relegated]] to clerical work. A village elder began to [[rejoice]]; the young trees might [[rejuvenate]] the valley. The commander’s new duty was to [[relate]] every seizure to its rightful owner and restore that [[relation]].

title: 钟声与相对时间
cn: 师父用两口钟讲相对时间。徒弟刚理解时差，便收到释放囚徒的传讯，决定先核验封印。
守卫借信仰惩罚囚徒。一个心有不忍的守卫让徒弟留下等待，他仔细测量而没有相信传闻。
院中的古物里有失踪钟表的残片。损伤解释了报时误差，也证明案发时囚徒身在别处，徒弟坚持要求法官复核。
en: An old master taught [[relativity]] through the [[relationship]] between two clocks. Each showed [[relative]] time, and the slower bell sounded [[relatively]] late. His student tried to [[relax]], but a message [[relay]] demanded the [[release]] of a prisoner.

The messenger’s [[reliability]] depended on a [[reliable]] seal. The student’s [[reliance]] on rumor had once failed; now he would [[rely]] on measurements. The prisoner found [[relief]] when the student came to [[relieve]] him of his chains. Guards used [[religion]] as an excuse for [[religious]] punishment and showed [[reluctance]] to admit error.

One [[reluctant]] guard took no [[relish]] in cruelty. He let the student [[remain]] until the [[remainder]] of the hearing ended. Ancient [[remains]] in the yard included a [[remnant]] of the missing clock. This was [[remarkable]]: its damage would [[remind]] the judges that the crime occurred elsewhere. The student’s [[remark]] was gentle, but he would [[remonstrate]] until they checked the time.

cn: 偏远旅馆在翻修期间仍出租危险房间。客人要求清除碎玻璃、修好楼梯并续办消防许可。

记者帮助替换假公告。演员成为住客代表，复印的旧许可又揭示官员曾压下投诉，旅馆终于停业修缮。

He began to [[repeat]] the promise [[repeatedly]], hoping [[repetition]] would conceal his [[repetitive]] lies. He could [[repel]] questions but did not [[repent]]. An actress whose [[repertoire]] included court dramas recorded his [[reply]].

A [[reporter]] helped them [[replace]] the false notice with a truthful [[replacement]]. The owner’s [[representation]] of his inn had misled customers; the actress would [[represent]] them as their elected [[representative]]. No [[reproach]] stopped her. title: 水库里的爬行动物
cn: 共和国派研究员调查水库怪兽。威胁信与旧地图共有同一个拼写错误，提示它们来自同一人。
湖边住户发现毒物残留，急需专业救援。实验室送来必需设备，调查开始从怪兽转向污染。
管理员想辞职，仍无法解释投药。他因升迁失败积怨，把储备药剂倒入水库。所谓怪兽其实是无害爬行动物，真正的责任人被揭露。
en: The [[republic]] sent a [[republican]] [[researcher]] to investigate a [[reptile]] near the [[reservoir]]. An old map misspelled it “[[reservior]],” a clue linking the threatening letters. Their [[resemblance]] to the map suggested the letters did [[resemble]] one writer’s work.

Residents who [[reside]] by the lake feared for the town’s [[reputation]]. A [[resident]] had abandoned her [[residential]] [[residence]] after finding [[residual]] poison. Her [[request]] for [[rescue]] would [[require]] specialist help; the [[requirement]] was urgent, and the laboratory supplied the [[requisite]] equipment.

The keeper planned to [[resign]], but his [[resignation]] could not explain the pollution. He seemed to [[resent]] the inspector, nursing [[resentment]] after a failed promotion. [[research|Research]] revealed that he had emptied the medical [[reserve]] into the water. The reptile was harmless; investigators cleared the creature and prosecuted the keeper.

title: 山谷共鸣试炼
cn: 女弟子带着抗幻盾进入共鸣山谷，要解决两位长老争夺泉源的旧怨。她坚定地听完各自说法。
两人的账册分别篡改春秋水量，灵体会重复每一个谎言。她保持尊重，却坚持核对记录。
长老试图约束她，她反而限制了扰乱泉水的法术。两人承担修管责任，泉水复原，山谷恢复丰收节。
en: A [[resolute]] disciple faced the valley’s [[resonance]]. To [[resist]] its illusion, she needed [[resistance]] training and a [[resistant]] shield. Her [[resolution]] was to [[resolve]] the old dispute over a mountain [[resort]] and its last water [[resource]].

Two elders demanded [[respect]], but neither behaved in a [[respectable]] way. She remained [[respectful]] and asked them to [[respond]]. Their [[respective]] records, dated spring and autumn [[respectively]], showed that each [[respondent]] had altered a measurement. A [[responsive]] spirit echoed every false [[response]].

The elders called her [[restless]] and tried to [[restrain]] her. She would [[restrict]] the spell and [[restore]] the spring. Each accepted [[responsibility]] for a broken pipe, becoming [[responsible]] for repairs. The [[result]] was clear water; the [[resultant]] peace allowed the valley to [[resume]] its harvest festival.

title: 退休店主的回信
cn: 准备退休的店主想留下账册，税务文书却声称会拖延店铺出售。她追问条文，对方的粗鲁使她起疑。
取回原合同后，她发现侄子因旧怨挪用收入，准备倒转账面数字侵吞店产。
律师核对合同后帮助追款。侄子的革命口号无法掩盖盗窃，店主把追回的钱捐给图书馆，使其重新开放。
en: A [[retail]] shopkeeper decided to [[retire]]. Before [[retirement]], she wanted to [[retain]] a ledger for memory. The tax clerk said its [[retention]] might [[retard]] a pending sale. She asked him to [[retell]] the rule, and his rude [[retort]] made her [[retreat]] into the shop.

In [[retrospect]], the clerk’s visit was strange. She would [[retrieve]] the real contract before a family [[reunion]]. Its [[revelation]] showed that a nephew wanted her property as [[revenge]] for an old quarrel. He had diverted the shop’s [[revenue]] and planned to [[reverse]] the figures.

A lawyer offered a [[review]], asking her to [[revise]] a date but refusing a dishonest [[revision]]. The nephew threatened a [[revolt]] and spoke of a [[revolution]], though no [[revolutionary]] cause justified theft. The shopkeeper’s answer made his scheme [[revolve]] around repayment. She used the recovered [[reward]] to [[revive]] the town’s small library.

title: 断裂的山脊琴
cn: 骑者在山脊听到断续琴声，发现肋骨受伤的歌者。他说琴中藏谜，守卫却嘲笑他。
严密检查发现琴框内藏着矿机金属环。村里的骚乱只是偷走成熟果实的掩护，歌者因目击而受伤。
池塘涟漪暴露小船，骑者冒险追去，在假丰收仪式中抓到歌者的对手。案件结束后，山脊再次响起乐声。
en: A [[rider]] heard a broken [[rhythm]] on a narrow [[ridge]]. A wounded bard had a cracked [[rib]] and a torn [[ribbon]]. He asked her to [[rid]] the instrument of a hidden [[riddle]], but village guards answered with [[ridicule]] and called the story [[ridiculous]].

The rider found a [[rifle]] beside a mining [[rig]]. A [[rigorous]] inspection disclosed a [[rigid]] metal [[rim]] inside the instrument. She would [[rinse]] its strings before someone could [[rip]] them away. A [[riot]] in the village was merely a diversion for stealing [[ripe]] fruit that would soon [[ripen]].

A [[ripple]] crossed the pond, revealing the thief’s boat. As water began to [[rise]], the rider took a [[risk]] and followed. She stopped the thief during his fake harvest [[ritual]]. His [[rivalry]] with the bard was no excuse. The bard’s former [[rival]] was caught, and music returned to the ridge.

title: 机器人的王冠
cn: 穿长袍的机器人漫游王家花园，播放狮吼，惊动了烤肉的厨师。众人不知道它究竟来做什么。
窃贼趁乱从屋顶偷走钱币，利用滚轮和模型火箭运送赃物。他先前以王室爱情研究为由进入宫中。
园丁发现机器人其实在浇花，旋转手臂控制了腐坏排水口上的阀门。博物馆的王冠被找回，王族向园丁致谢。

A [[robber]] tried to [[rob]] the treasury during the confusion. The [[robbery]] involved a model [[rocket]], a copper [[rod]], and a [[roller]] that made coins [[roll]] across the [[roof]]. An old [[roman|Roman]] coin lay among the stolen pieces. A [[romantic]] tale of royal [[romance]] had disguised the thief’s visit.

The gardener heard a [[rooster]] and traced the [[root]] of the noise to a speaker tied with [[rope]]. A [[rose]] bush had begun to [[rot]] below a [[rotten]] drain; its [[rotary]] valve would [[rotate]] with every [[rotation]] of the robot’s arm. The machine was watering plants. Its recovered crown belonged to the museum, and the [[royalty]] thanked the gardener.

en: A [[rough]] sketch showed [[roughly]] where the old [[route]] crossed a [[rural]] lake. The ferry made a [[roundabout]] journey as part of its [[routine]]. A passenger could [[row]] beside it, but a sudden [[rush]] would [[rouse]] the sleeping captain.

A [[ruthless]] trader wanted the ferry sunk to gain the crossing rights. Yet a [[rusty]] hinge showed fresh [[rust]] beside a replaced [[ruler]]. title: 海员的免罪旗
cn: 海员升旗驶过海峡，船员因病愁苦。他坚持安全优先，不让船主用削减工资代替防护。
游方圣者带着食物上船，发现促销鱼货已经腐败。他请船长向坚持不用坏鱼的厨师致意。
食物样本揭穿供应商，港务法庭批准救援。船员登陆沙岸扑灭货箱火苗，带回带供应商标记的鱼罐头作证。

A wandering [[saint]] boarded for the [[sake]] of helping the sick. He carried [[salad]], a [[sandwich]], and [[salmon]] with a little [[salt]]. At a [[sale]], a [[salesman]] had called spoiled fish [[saleable]]. The saint asked the captain to [[salute]] the honest cook instead.

A [[sample]] of food proved the fraud. The harbor court gave its [[sanction]] to a rescue boat, whose arrival brought [[salvation]]. They landed on [[sandy]] ground and covered a burning crate with [[sand]]. A discarded [[sardine]] tin bore the supplier’s mark. The captain paid the crew and testified against the merchant.

cn: 学者观察土星时，镜壳受潮发出饱和警报，资助者不满成像结果。她拿出积蓄抢救镜片。
窃贼打翻厨房酱汁，用锯子切开天文台门闩，留下有旧伤痕的血色围巾。
暗处证据稀少，假尖叫又想吓走学者。她等到日出，找到镜片和被隐匿的经费，揭发负责财务的人。
en: A scholar aimed a [[satellite]] mirror at [[saturn|Saturn]]. The telescope’s [[saturation]] alarm sounded when moisture began to [[saturate]] the casing. She could not [[satisfy]] her patrons; their expected [[satisfaction]] required a [[satisfactory]] image produced [[satisfactorily]].

A [[savage]] thief used a spilled [[sauce]] to distract the cook. A [[saucer]] broke beside a plate of [[sausage]], and someone cut the observatory latch with a [[saw]]. The scholar used her last [[saving|savings]] to [[save]] the lens. The thief had left a [[scarlet]] [[scarf]] bearing a familiar [[scar]].

Police would [[scan]] the cloth at the right [[scale]]. A [[scandal]] arose over a funding [[scarcity]], although funds were merely hidden. Evidence was [[scarce]], and the scholar could [[scarcely]] identify the culprit in darkness. A staged [[scary]] scream tried to [[scare]] her away. She waited for sunrise, found the stolen mirror, and exposed her treasurer.

title: 被涂改的圣典剧本
cn: 侦探在庭院闻到纸张焦味，研究圣典的学者却在讲座前失踪。官方时间表隐藏了他的最后约见。
科学分析表明有人从圣典剪走剧本。院长嘲笑调查并责骂园丁，但焦黑铲子不属于园丁的工具。
年轻侦察员翻墙发现院长未刮净的纸屑，又从雕塑下听到求救。学者在地窖获救，院长无法洗去证据。
en: Falling leaves began to [[scatter]] across the [[scene]]. A detective admired the garden’s [[scenery]], then caught the [[scent]] of burned paper. A [[sceptical]] [[scholar]] had vanished before his [[scholarship]] lecture, and the official [[schedule]] concealed his last appointment.

A [[scientist]] offered a [[scientific]] account of the ash. Someone had used [[scissors]] to cut a [[script]] from a volume of [[scripture]]. The dean would [[scoff]] at the suggestion and [[scold]] the gardener. Yet a metal [[scoop]] had a [[scorch]] mark that lay beyond the gardener’s working [[scope]].

A young [[scout]] began to [[scramble]] over the wall. She found a [[scrap]] the dean had tried to [[scrape]] away, leaving a [[scratch]] under the window [[screen]]. A loose [[screw]] allowed entry. The missing scholar’s [[scream]] came from below a [[sculpture]]. After a careful [[scrutiny]] of the cellar, police rescued him. The dean could not [[scrub]] the evidence clean or improve his credibility [[score]] with another sneer of [[scorn]].

title: 港口封条下的种子
cn: 海员带种子回港，封条却遮住一道暗缝。哥哥买旧船的安逸计划暂缓，两人先寻找失踪货物。
箱内地图显示洪水农田的分区。有人故意不发种子给贫困家庭，企图把村民隔离。
守卫试抢地图，海员组织见证人公平核实。守卫与商贩勾结的事实被揭露，种子归还农户，两兄弟在学校教授种植。
en: A [[seaman]] returned to a [[seaport]] carrying [[seed|seeds]] in a [[secure]] box. Its [[seal]] crossed a hidden [[seam]]. His [[sedentary]] brother wanted a quiet [[seaside]] life and had bought a [[second-hand]] boat, a [[secondary]] concern beside the missing cargo.

First they would [[search]] the dock; [[secondly]], they would [[seek]] the seller. The box’s [[secret]] [[section]] held a map of the flooded agricultural [[sector]]. [[security|Security]] officers had [[seemingly]] ignored this [[segment]] of the shipment. Someone planned to [[segregate]] farm families by denying seed to poorer houses.

A guard tried to [[seize]] the map. He [[seldom]] met resistance, but the sailor asked villagers to [[select]] witnesses for a fair [[selection]]. The guard’s [[self]]-importance exposed his [[selfish]] purpose: he worked for the [[seller]]. The brothers returned the seeds and taught planting at the school during the next [[semester]].

title: 议员的第十七场布道
cn: 资深议员借半导体研讨会宣传神奇教学机器，许诺它们像播种一样传播知识。工程师却认为承诺荒谬。
传感器显示机器过热，调查员逐句核查演说。议员试图把技术事实与情绪分开，但拆开的导线暴露了异常。
警官根据序列号找到成批失窃设备。十七天后，议员又一次布道时，讲台雕蛇掉落，露出偷来的部件，仆人出庭证实盗窃。

A [[sensitive]] [[sensor]] revealed the device’s true [[sensitivity]] to heat. A [[sensible]] investigator checked each [[sentence]] in the speech and made [[sense]] of its borrowed wording. The senator tried to [[separate]] technical facts from political [[sentiment]], but a [[separation]] of the wiring told another story.

A [[sergeant]] inspected the machines [[separately]]. Their [[serial]] numbers formed a [[series]] of thefts. The matter was [[serious]], and he took it [[seriously]]. After [[seventeen]] days, during the senator’s next [[sermon]], a carved [[serpent]] fell from the podium and exposed a stolen component. A [[servant]] testified at the next [[session]]; the senator’s [[seventy]] supporters finally stopped applauding.

title: 影井中的假王
cn: 边界争议使加冕受阻，摄政者的严酷处罚进一步破坏信任。他还以性别偏见禁止女裁缝进入宫廷工坊。
裁缝在阴影里见一个人走进暗道，影子指向干井井筒。她跟过去发现梯子摇晃。
浅台阶下藏着真正的君主，加冕只是一场骗局。裁缝用洗发液润开脏绳结，救出君主并揭穿摄政者。
en: A [[setback]] halted the coronation. The [[setting]] was a [[shabby]] court beside a dry well; nobody could [[settle]] the boundary dispute or achieve a [[settlement]]. The regent’s [[severe]] punishments had damaged trust [[severely]].

A tailor asked to [[sew]] new robes without restrictions based on [[sex]]. The regent’s [[sexism]] had barred women from court workshops and spread cruel [[sexual]] gossip. In the [[shade]], the tailor saw a [[shadowy]] figure enter a [[shady]] passage. His [[shadow]] reached the well’s [[shaft]].

The tailor felt the ladder [[shake]], but her [[shaky]] hands found a [[shallow]] ledge. The coronation was a [[sham]]; the real ruler lay below. The regent’s behavior brought [[shame]] and proved [[shameful]]. She used a bottle of [[shampoo]] to loosen the captive’s dirty bonds, pulled him free, and revealed the true [[shape]] of the conspiracy.

title: 锋刃与羊毛的交易
cn: 牧羊人与海边治安官谈羊毛交易。鲨鱼传闻令船只停航，牧羊人带刀准备割网，却遭严厉拒绝。
棚屋里的盾牌后藏着货箱，架上染血布单遮住假先令。治安官的恐慌远超一场普通交易。
他想归罪造船工，但失踪货物正是伪币，所谓沉船也是编造。牧羊人举盾挡住威胁，呼来正直守卫，交易变成证词。
en: A [[shepherd]] agreed to [[share]] wool with a coastal [[sheriff]]. Rumors of a [[shark]] attack had made the boats unsafe. The shepherd carried a [[sharp]] blade and offered to [[sharpen]] it for cutting nets, but the sheriff spoke [[sharply]] and tried to [[shatter]] the bargain.

A [[shield]] concealed a box inside the [[shed]]. The shepherd could [[shear]] his sheep or [[shave]] his beard with the blade, yet neither task explained the sheriff’s [[sheer]] panic. A bloodstained [[sheet]] lay on a [[shelf]] beside a painted [[shell]]. It hid a counterfeit [[shilling]].

The sheriff would [[shift]] blame to the [[shipbuilding]] workers. But a missing [[shipment]] included those counterfeit coins, and the supposed [[shipwreck]] had never happened. A cold [[shiver]] went through the shepherd at the [[shock]]. When the sheriff threatened to [[shoot]], the shepherd raised his shield and called the honest guards. The wool bargain became testimony.

title: 盐铺的速记员
cn: 盐铺晚间盘点发现短缺，文书用速记加快审计。很快有人开枪并把他推向木箱。
精明搬运工用铁锹打翻盐袋，盐粒像阵雨落下，袭击者尖叫逃走。
撒落的虾标出逃向神龛的路线。搬运工认真听证人描述，在灌木与庙窗后找到盗货的会计，速记账表成为证据。
en: A [[shopkeeper]] noticed a [[shortfall]] after the evening [[shopping]]. The [[shore]] depot reported a [[shortage]], though its main [[shortcoming]] was poor accounting. A clerk proposed a [[shortcut]] to [[shorten]] the audit and wrote the figures in [[shorthand]].

[[shortly|Shortly]] afterward, a [[shot]] sounded. The clerk clutched his [[shoulder]] as someone tried to [[shove]] him into a crate. A [[shrewd]] porter picked up a [[shovel]] and knocked over a sack, raising a salt [[shower]]. A [[shrill]] [[shriek]] came from the attacker.

A spilled basket of [[shrimp]] marked his escape toward a [[shrine]]. The porter would not [[shrug]] away a witness’s fear: she watched the man [[shrink]] behind a [[shrub]], then [[shut]] the temple [[shutter]]. A stopped [[shuttle]] bus blocked his way. The supposedly [[shy]] accountant was the thief; the clerk’s shorthand proved the diversion of stock.

title: 围城中的银色筛子
cn: 围城期间，病中的女医带筛子穿过窄门，发现受伤斥候。他拿着盖有伪造签名的投降令。
队长强令沉默，可纸上有工坊硅尘与银墨。医师在药瓶上找到相同的封印，手套也沾着同类粉尘。
她用两盏灯同时照射，重现伪造图案。简明的演示证明投降令是骗局，城墙守住了。
en: A physician’s [[sickness]] trapped her during the [[siege]]. She moved [[sideways]] through a narrow door, carrying a [[sieve]] to [[sift]] medicine. A soldier’s [[sigh]] drew her [[sight]] toward a wounded scout; ordinary [[sightseeing]] would have missed that faint [[sign]].

The scout showed a forged [[signature]]. Its [[significance]] was [[significant]] because it could [[signify]] orders to surrender. The [[silent]] captain enforced [[silence]], calling the allegation [[silly]]. Yet the letter contained [[silicon]] dust from a workshop and traces of [[silver]] ink.

The physician found a [[similar]] seal on a bottle. This [[similarity]] linked the captain to the forgery; [[similarly]], his gloves held the same dust. She valued [[simplicity]] and sought to [[simplify]] the proof. Two lamps could [[simulate]] the seal under [[simultaneous]] beams. When they shone [[simultaneously]], the forged emblem became visible. The city held its walls.

title: 六十楼的歌手
cn: 歌手向何探员坦白一次小过错，真诚令他愿意听完整段证词。录音里却出现不可能传到内陆高楼的船笛。
六十楼客厅的素描画着电梯井中的骷髅。歌手回忆与失踪者滑冰滑雪的往事，认为鬼魂来访。
技师打开井壁，找到人造骷髅和仿真皮肤。所谓鬼魂是掩饰，录音中的船笛引警方赶到真正码头，查明沉尸企图。
en: A [[sincere]] [[singer]] confessed one [[sin]] before a concert. Her [[sincerity]] impressed Detective He, who found her alone in a [[single]] apartment. The [[singular]] clue was a ship’s [[siren]] recorded at a building [[site]] inland.

The flat’s [[sitting-room]] was [[situated]] on floor [[sixty]]. Its [[situation]] made the sound impossible. He took a [[sip]] of tea while she described learning to [[skate]] and [[ski]] with the missing victim. A [[sketch]] on the wall showed a [[skeleton]] inside a lift shaft.

He remained [[skeptical]] of ghosts. A [[skilled]] technician used her [[skill]] to open the shaft in a [[skillful]] way. She would [[skim]] the maintenance log, then [[skip]] the false entries. Beneath a damaged panel were an artificial [[skull]] and scraps resembling [[skin]]. The killer had tried to make the victim [[sink]] into a reservoir, but the singer’s recording led police to the real dock.

cn: 雪夜贫民区里，男孩守着困倦的监护人。她曾逃脱奴役，如今工作衰退又使一家无处可去。
房东辱骂他们，用松电线甩门。油洼里的面包片使台阶湿滑，男孩摔倒擦伤后从门缝逃出求助。
邻居发现所有出口都要投币，安全口号只是幌子。她破锁救出一家，并揭发房东屠杀流浪犬、调开守卫的残忍计划。
en: A [[slender]] boy lived in a [[slum]] below a [[skyscraper]]. His [[sleepy]] guardian lay in [[slumber]] as a labor [[slump]] emptied the streets. Once a [[slave]], she had escaped [[slavery]], and the boy refused to leave her in the [[snowstorm]].

A [[sly]] landlord used [[slang]] to [[slander]] them. He let a [[slack]] wire [[slam]] a door, then tried to [[slap]] the boy. A [[slice]] of bread lay in a [[slick]] pool of oil, making the step [[slippery]]; the boy’s [[slipper]] began to [[slide]] and [[slip]]. His [[slim]] frame escaped through a [[slit]], with only a [[slight]] bruise that hurt [[slightly]].

Outside, a [[smart]] neighbor saw a [[snowy]] [[slope]] through the [[smog]]. The landlord’s [[slogan]] promised safety, but a coin [[slot]] controlled every exit. She walked [[slowly]], refused his order to [[slash]] their blankets, and used a stone to [[smash]] the lock. A planned [[slaughter]] of stray dogs had distracted the guards; she exposed both cruelties and took the family to shelter.

title: 蜗牛递来的密信
cn: 傲慢商人把蛇藏进厨房货箱，学徒偷偷目睹他顺走点心。商人想趁守夜人昏睡偷盗。
喷嚏声令学徒察觉异常香料，桌下蜗牛还带着求救便条。她不理商人的嘲讽，洗去纸封外层，露出真实印记。
所谓珍奇蛇并不危险。学徒用风筝传出消息，守夜人获救后清醒作证，院里的足球游戏恢复。
en: A [[smooth]] talking [[snob]] arrived at the academy, acting [[snobbish]] toward the gatekeeper. He tried to [[smuggle]] a [[snake]] into a food crate. A hidden apprentice watched him [[sneak]] around the kitchen and [[snatch]] a [[snack]].

The apprentice heard a [[snap]], then a [[sneeze]]. Rather than [[sneer]], she stopped to [[sniff]] the strange spice. A tiny [[snail]] carried a note beneath the table. It said the merchant would drug the watchman, making him [[snore]] while the theft went [[smoothly]].

The [[so-called]] rare snake was harmless. The apprentice would [[soak]] the note’s cover in water and wash it with [[soap]], uncovering its wax seal. She used a small kite to let the message [[soar]] over the wall. The rescued watchman began to [[sob]], then grew [[sober]] as he described the thief. The kitchen’s evening [[soccer]] game resumed after the guards arrested him.

title: 盐井下的空洞
cn: 社会学学生调查矿区冲突。矿工关心井水安全，沙发旁的一只袜子引她找到矿主的暗室。
盐类和柔软布料遮着蜡封钥匙。软件记录与太阳能传感器证明土壤受污染，毒井是居民患病的源头。
律师保护证人，工人团结起来，用可溶染料追踪水流。打开暗室后，证据完整，毒井关闭。
en: A [[sociology]] student studied a [[social]] conflict in a mining [[society]]. A [[socialist]] lecturer discussed [[socialism]], but the miners asked for safe wells rather than slogans. A [[sock]] found near a [[sofa]] connected the owner to a hidden chamber.

Inside lay [[soda]] and [[sodium]] salts on [[soft]] cloth. A warm lamp could [[soften]] the wax, whose [[softness]] hid a stolen key. The student spoke [[softly]] and searched the old [[software]] records. A [[solar]] sensor measured contaminated [[soil]], the [[sole]] source of the town’s illness.

A [[solemn]] [[solicitor]] came [[solely]] to protect the witnesses. Their [[solidarity]] formed a [[solid]] defense, though the owner tried to [[solidify]] fear into silence. A miner sang a [[solo]] while workers tested a [[soluble]] dye. Its trail offered a [[solution]]: the case was [[solvable]]. They would [[solve]] it by opening the chamber and closing the poisoned well.

cn: 老练窃贼闯入总督宅邸，假扮厨子，过分加工简单食谱，把汤做酸。总督则为家族纪念章失窃悲痛。
纪念章来自祖辈战时救援，感情价值远高于价格。厨子沿南门脚印向东南花园追查。
转向西南的车上，大豆袋下面藏着纪念章和播种工具。窃贼又扮园丁逃走，酸汤帮助辨认其身份并揭出下毒企图。
en: A [[sophisticated]] thief had [[somehow]] entered the governor’s house. A cook recalled that he had come [[sometime]] before dusk, looking [[somewhat]] [[sore]]. His attempt to [[sophisticate]] a simple recipe had ruined the [[soup]], making it [[sour]].

The [[sorrowful]] governor showed genuine [[sorrow]] over a lost [[souvenir]]. He insisted the medal was the [[soul]] of his family, though this [[sort]] of sentiment puzzled the cook. A [[soviet|Soviet]] officer had given it to a [[sovereign]] ancestor; its real [[source]] was a wartime rescue.

The cook checked the [[southern]] gate, then followed footsteps [[southwards]] toward the [[southeast]] garden. A cart turned toward the [[southwest]]. Beneath a bag of [[soy]], the medal lay beside a tool used to [[sow]] seed. The thief had disguised himself as a gardener, but the sour soup identified the unfamiliar cook who had tried to poison the household.

title: 金星舟的西班牙图谱
cn: 天文台的西班牙图谱记录星舟航线，但水晶坐标突然改变。麻雀停在窗边，一点火花令晶体闪亮。
导航专家带来特制长矛，要求学徒测试晶体。他的资历光鲜，却愿意为钱接任何任务。
学徒坚持核对具体规格。图谱展开的景象壮观，光谱却揭示晶体伪造，她在桥下挖回真正水晶。
en: A [[spacious]] observatory held a [[spanish|Spanish]] atlas of [[space]]. Its drawings showed a [[spaceship]] and a smaller [[spacecraft]] crossing the sky. A [[sparrow]] perched on the window as a [[spark]] made a crystal [[sparkle]]. The crystal’s [[spatial]] coordinates had changed.

A [[speaker]] at the guild meeting claimed [[special]] knowledge. He was a [[specialist]] whose [[speciality]] was navigation and whose other [[specialty]] was metalwork. He would [[specialize]] in any task for money, bringing a [[specially]] forged [[spear]] that he wanted the apprentice to test.

The apprentice demanded a [[specific]] [[specification]], asking him [[specifically]] to [[specify]] the crystal’s limits. A rare bird [[species]] supplied the feather [[specimen]] inside it. When the atlas opened, a [[spectacular]] [[spectacle]] drew every [[spectator]]. Yet its altered light [[spectrum]] betrayed the forged crystal. The apprentice refused to [[speculate]] beyond the evidence and dug a [[spade]] deep to recover the stolen real one beneath a bridge [[span]].

title: 螺旋塔中的失语人
cn: 男子爬过球形高塔后失语，医生让他拼写线索。他指向香料瓶内的小球，瓶口有蛛网。
他曾目击守卫投毒，逃走时在螺旋楼梯伤了脊柱。守卫诬称他是邪灵，又恶意侮辱他。
水盆溅水显出守卫袖上污痕。医生拒绝发言人的奖赏，擦出赞助徽章上的名字，带男子接受治疗。他恢复语言后指认守卫。
en: A man lost his [[speech]] after climbing a [[spherical]] tower. The doctor tested the [[speed]] of his pulse, then asked him to [[spell]] one word. His [[spelling]] pointed to a small [[sphere]] hidden inside a jar of [[spice]].

A [[spider]] web marked the jar. The man had seen a guard [[spill]] poison, then [[spin]] the jar to conceal it. His damaged [[spine]] needed [[spinal]] treatment, and the [[spiral]] stairs had made escape impossible. The guard called him an evil [[spirit]] and tried to [[spit]] at him in [[spite]].

A [[splash]] from the doctor’s basin exposed the guard’s stained sleeve. A [[spokesman]] promised a [[splendid]] prize if she would [[split]] her testimony, but she would not [[spoil]] the evidence. She wiped it with a [[sponge]], found the donor’s name on a [[sponsor]] badge, and took the man to safety. His first recovered word identified the guard.

cn: 运动员在广场找到失踪配偶，她举着瓷勺指向水果摊。喷洒的香味引来人群。
摊贩假称春季生长粉能助长植物，实为标记偷窃目标的染料。侦察员看到他在南瓜与松鼠笼后挤压药袋。
运动员用勺柄制服持刀摊贩，并在货箱后找到失窃球票。配偶因目击盗窃被扣留，获救后乘稳固的小车回家。
en: A [[sportsman]] found his missing [[spouse]] in a market [[square]]. She held a white [[spoon]] and pointed to a [[spot]] under the fruit stall. A [[spontaneous]] crowd gathered as perfume [[spray]] began to [[spread]] through the air.

It was [[springtime]], and the vendor promised that the powder he would [[sprinkle]] could [[spur]] plant growth. A village [[spy]] asked the rescue [[squad]] to wait. He watched the vendor [[squat]] beside a [[squash]], then [[squeeze]] a pouch hidden behind a [[squirrel]] cage.

The powder was theft-marking dye. The vendor planned to [[stab]] customers who followed him, so the athlete disarmed him with the spoon. A [[stable]] cart provided [[stability]] for the rescued woman; ropes would [[stabilize]] its broken wheel. Behind a [[stack]] of crates they found stolen entrance tickets for the town [[stadium]]. The missing woman had been held because she saw the theft.

cn: 职员在剧场突然踉跄，胸牌沾着茶渍。楼梯口被木桩堵住，他无法离开。
厨房只有陈面包，厨子说话结巴。法官耐心让他陈述，不用惊吓逼供。
记录揭示政客挪用食物，工人正面临饥饿。法官用固定摄像资料核对单据，找出失踪配送，并建立一致检查标准。

The kitchen’s [[staple]] bread was [[stale]], and a severed herb [[stalk]] lay by the [[stall]]. The cook would [[stammer]] when asked to [[state]] what happened. A judge did not [[startle]] him; she let him give a [[statement]] from his own [[standpoint]].

The inquiry found that workers faced [[starvation]], while a [[statesman]] had diverted food. They would [[starve]] if a rigid [[standard]] stayed unchanged. The judge proposed to [[standardize]] inspections, checking a [[static]] display against a [[stationary]] camera. A receipt among the [[stationery]] exposed the missing deliveries. title: 统计师与石像

厨师以炉上蒸汽遮掩见证人的秘密会面，船上服务员准备好逃生船只。众人逐步收集证词。
石像底部的草茎标记藏着失窃选票。法官拒绝官员对工人的偏见，让所有人重新投票。
en: A [[statistical]] clerk questioned a royal [[statistic]]: every worker was supposedly content. The [[statistics]] counted only people of high [[status]]. A [[statute]] barred poorer voices from the vote, while a triumphant [[statue]] stood outside the office.

A [[steady]] cook [[steadily]] gathered witnesses. He served [[steak]] and [[stew]] from a [[steel]] [[stove]], letting the [[steam]] hide their meeting. A harbor [[steamer]] could carry them away if guards came. A [[steward]] and a [[stewardess]] agreed to [[steer]] it through a [[steep]] inlet.

The clerk took a [[step]] toward the statue and found a plant [[stem]] stuffed in its base. It marked the hiding place of stolen ballots. The official had tried to [[steal]] them while a [[stereo]] played above. A [[stern]] judge rejected his [[stereotype]] of ignorant workers and opened the vote to everyone.

cn: 仓库股东拒绝在风暴前搬货。搬运工坐在石墙边，楼上石块突然落下，他只能拄杖查看。
粘包裹里的破袜针脚藏毒，接触后他腹痛，邻居急忙调药。粘胶也解释了被卡住的报警机构。
他缓过来后讲清经过。股东制造假警报赶走工人，准备纵火骗保，风雨及时扑灭火苗。

After the frightening [[stillness]], he gave a [[straightforward]] account. A small [[stimulus]] had been used to [[stimulate]] a fire alarm and drive workers outside. He would [[straighten]] his [[stiff]] leg and help inspectors recover the package. The stockholder had engineered an insurance fire; the storm extinguished it before anyone died.

title: 海峡里的陌生人
cn: 陌生人请求穿过海峡，船带却磨损，急流几乎让船搁浅。船长部署救援，反复加固绳索。
躲在稻草与草莓箱下的是逃亡勒颈凶犯，他等天上红霞出现便动手。强水流让藏身处暴露。
严格执行拉绳命令的船员看到条纹绳，认出凶犯。一次果断打击将其制服，众人继续合作抵岸。
en: A [[stranger]] sought passage through the [[strait]]. The harbor’s [[strategic]] watchtower followed a rescue [[strategy]], but a frayed [[strap]] put the boat under [[strain]]. It could [[strand]] everyone on a sandbank.

A notorious [[strangler]] hid beneath [[straw]] and a basket of [[strawberry|strawberries]]. He planned to [[stray]] into the captain’s room after a red [[streak]] appeared in the sky. A fast [[stream]] nearly exposed him. The captain tried to [[streamline]] the rescue and [[strengthen]] the ropes with all her [[strength]].

Under [[stress]], she ordered the crew to [[stretch]] a line. A [[strict]] sailor followed [[strictly]], taking a long [[stride]] toward the stern. He saw the criminal’s striped [[string]] beside a cloth [[strip]] with a blue [[stripe]]. There was brief [[strife]], then a single [[strike]] disarmed the man. Everyone continued to [[strive]] for shore, and the captain’s [[striking]] courage saved them.

cn: 固执画家在闷热画室中轻微中风，来客却阻止他出门。梁柱受损使脱身更加困难。
学徒在雕刻树桩后发现潜艇草图：盗贼准备把偷来的画沉入海中，还想药倒画家。
港口艺术社群共同分区搜寻，制服入侵者并提交证据。调查以潜艇计划为核心，画家康复后为救援者画像。
en: A [[stubborn]] artist suffered a minor [[stroke]] in a [[stuffy]] [[studio]]. He wanted to [[stroll]] outside, but a visitor would [[strongly]] oppose it. A damaged [[structural]] beam weakened the building’s [[structure]], making escape a [[struggle]].

A [[sturdy]] apprentice would not [[stumble]] over the visitor’s discarded [[stuff]]. Behind a carved [[stump]] she found sketches of a [[submarine]] and plans to [[submerge]] stolen paintings. The thief wanted to [[stun]] the artist with medicine and called the apprentice [[stupid]].

The artist’s unique [[style]] had inspired a harbor [[subculture]]. Friends would [[subdivide]] the studio to search, [[subdue]] the intruder, and [[submit]] evidence rather than make a [[subjective]] accusation. A [[subordinate]] investigator made the submarine plan the [[subject]] of inquiry. The artist recovered and painted the rescuers.

交付物并非约定谷物。购买者通过污痕和空箱重量证明缺额，地铁清洁工帮助追回废标签。

en: A family in the [[suburb]] agreed to [[subscribe]] to a food box. Its [[subscription]] required a [[subscript]] code after the address. A [[subsequent]] letter changed the price, and [[subsequently]] a [[subsidiary]] company claimed the town’s [[subsidy]].

The delivered [[substance]] was [[substantially]] different from the promised grain. A cheap [[substitute]] had replaced it. A [[subtle]] stain let the buyer [[subtract]] the empty box’s weight and prove the shortfall. A [[subway]] cleaner helped recover discarded labels.

The organizer expected to [[succeed]] through confusion, but the buyer’s [[success]] changed the [[succeeding]] hearing. Two [[successive]] tests were [[successful]], and she [[successfully]] traced the shipments. cn: 旅店套房传来硫磺气味，破风扇把 毒气 吹向客人。箱上和送货单使用两种英文拼写。
经理擅自声称是自杀，医师拒绝猜测，先安排通风救人。房间缺少适合住客的防护。
幸存者起诉，医师汇总未完成维修。两种标签都指向经理的进货单，他无视警告把药粉放在炉旁，案件转为失职投毒调查。
en: A [[sullen]] guest left a [[suitcase]] in a hotel [[suite]]. A [[sudden]] odor made the porter [[suddenly]] cough; a broken fan could [[suck]] fumes toward visitors. A label read “[[sulfur]],” while the delivery slip used “[[sulphur]].”

The manager’s [[suggestion]] was to call it [[suicide]], but the medic rejected that guess. A safe room must [[suit]] its guests and contain [[suitable]] ventilation. The victims would [[suffer]] if a window did not [[suffice]]. [[sufficient|Sufficient]] airflow had to reach the room [[sufficiently]] quickly.

A survivor chose to [[sue]]. The medic calculated the [[sum]] of unpaid repairs, then would [[summarize]] them in a [[summary]]. Both spellings on the labels belonged to the manager’s invoices. He had stored the powder beside a furnace despite repeated warnings; the deaths were investigated as negligent poisoning.

山管以优越知识自夸，实际用隐藏喷嘴的超音速气流制造骇人轰响，诱使香客迷信。弟子要求监督维修。
日落时冷却与支撑补件装好，设备被拆走。学院愿提供帮助，山管的头衔也不能压下调查，清净钟声恢复。

By [[sunset]], she had added a cooling [[supplement]] and [[supplementary]] braces. The academy would [[supply]] honest [[support]], though officials did [[suppose]] the master might [[suppress]] the report. No [[supreme]] title could hide the lie. The mountain would [[surely]] recover its peaceful music once the device was removed.

cn: 风暴洪水淹过医院，外科医师救活一名无登记姓氏的伤者。捐款超过需求，却出现物资失踪。
医生封守库房并调查周边，灾民的生存不能再等。负责财务的人仍拒绝交出账目。
易受感染的病人认出财务官，拒绝吞药。停职调查迫使官员交代，他把补给藏进有白天鹅的沼泽。物资追回，伤者姓名也终于补录。
en: A [[surge]] flooded the hospital. A [[surgeon]] performed [[surgery]] on a [[survivor]] whose [[surname]] was missing from the list. Donations began to [[surpass]] costs, but the [[surplus]] vanished. This was [[surprising]], and [[surprisingly]] the treasurer offered to [[surrender]] no records.

Doctors asked soldiers to [[surround]] the storeroom while surveying the [[surrounding]] streets. The town’s [[surroundings]] needed a careful [[survey]] for other victims. [[survival|Survival]] depended on food arriving soon; even strong people could not [[survive]] long without it.

A [[susceptible]] patient refused to [[swallow]] the medicine after recognizing the treasurer as a [[suspect]]. His [[suspension]] from duties could [[sustain]] the investigation. Under pressure, he admitted hiding supplies in a [[swamp]] near a white [[swan]]. Surgeons recovered them, and the missing surname finally returned to the record.

title: 蜂群中的瑞士剑
cn: 瑞士旅人以毛衣换剑时，蜂群突然在摊上摇动。养蜂人喷糖浆驱赶，反使蜂群膨胀。
旅人挥剑击中暗开关，蜜蜂舞动方式改变。蜂群象征行会，实际受到镜面反光引导。
乐师发现对称镜面有一处堵塞，安抚众人并在研讨会解释。异常并非诅咒，挥剑只是意外恢复光线。
en: A [[swiss|Swiss]] traveler offered to [[swap]] a [[sweater]] for a local [[sword]]. A [[swarm]] of bees began to [[sway]] over the stall. The traveler would [[swear]] he had not disturbed them, though [[sweat]] covered his face.

The keeper tried to [[sweep]] the bees away and [[sweeten]] the air with syrup. Its [[sweetness]] made the swarm [[swell]]. A [[swift]] movement of the traveler’s arm made the sword [[swing]], striking a hidden [[switch]]. The bees were a [[symbol]] of the keeper’s guild, and their [[symbolic]] dance depended on reflected light.

A [[sympathetic]] musician noticed the mirrors’ [[symmetry]]. She could [[sympathize]] with the frightened crowd without losing reason. Her quiet [[symphony]] calmed the keeper; at a later [[symposium]], she explained that a blocked mirror caused the bee [[symptom]], not a curse or a mysterious [[syndrome]]. The sword’s blow had accidentally restored the light.

A volunteer [[team]] followed the footprints to a [[telescope]] shop. The clerk tried to [[tease]] the boy, then [[tear]] the message. But the boy remembered the contraband’s bitter [[taste]]. Its ropes had poor [[tensile]] strength, a dangerous [[tendency]] during storms. The healer made a [[tentative]] plan to move everyone.

The local [[terminal]] displayed an unfamiliar medical [[term]]. A glossary of [[terminology]] let her [[terminate]] a harmful infusion. cn: 感恩节演出前，剧院收到恐袭威胁。警方请服装师作证，她根据教材里的图案定理辨认失窃布料。

热成像与温度计找到定时加热的柜子，证明所谓炸弹其实是舞台幻术。真正罪犯借威胁趁乱盗取慈善款。

The curtain’s [[textile]] [[texture]] matched the stolen cloth. This was the play’s [[theme]], yet a [[theoretical]] calculation showed the thief had cut a specific square. A survivor receiving [[therapy]] described the cloth; [[thereafter]], investigators examined the dressing room.

A [[thermal]] camera and a [[thermometer]] found a warm locker, [[thereby]] uncovering a timed heater [[therein]]. An officer could [[therefore]] reject the supposed explosive device. The maker’s [[thesis]] and fragments [[thereof]] explained the harmless stage illusion. The real criminal used the terror threat to steal charity money, not to destroy the theatre.

title: 荆棘王座下的麦穗
cn: 小偷为夺王家种子钻进厚篱笆，伤了大腿又极度口渴。他开始想求助并坦白。
体贴守卫仔细搜查伤口，没有执行国王草率的鞭打令。衣服线头引他们发现王座下的暗门。
贵族藏粮的事实暴露，流血拇指证明小偷曾触及暗门。追回的小麦帮助村民度冬，小偷也终于喝到水。
en: A [[thief]] approached a [[thick]] hedge to steal royal seed. Its [[thickness]] would [[thicken]] with spring growth. He cut his [[thigh]] and began [[thinking]] of escape. First he needed water; second he needed help; [[thirdly]], he had to confess.

His [[thirst]] made him [[thirsty]], and a [[thorn]] tore his sleeve. A [[thoughtful]] guard made a [[thorough]] search and checked the wound [[thoroughly]]. The king’s [[thoughtless]] order to [[thrash]] thieves could turn one bad [[thought]] into a death sentence.

A loose [[thread]] led them beneath the [[throne]], where a noble had hidden grain. His [[threat]] silenced the [[throng]] [[throughout]] the court. The guard raised the thief’s injured [[thumb]] to show blood on the secret door, then [[thrust]] it open. The town could [[thresh]] the recovered wheat and [[thrive]] again. A [[thrifty]] ration plan saved the winter, and the thief felt a [[thrill]] when his parched [[throat]] met clean water.

title: 雷潮中的木材时刻表
cn: 雷声与涨潮使胆小文书紧张，他仍整理码头、绑紧货箱。笼中老虎撞动甲板，屋顶瓦片倾斜。
小铁盒中藏着及时警告：木材船时刻表被改动。搬运工提供的线索证实有人破坏绑绳。
繁琐检查使他手掌被木屑扎伤，但他抄下业主头衔并报警。延迟出航救了船员，安静的文书证明了勇气。
en: A [[timid]] clerk heard [[thunder]] above the pier. A clock’s [[tick]] seemed to [[tickle]] his nerves, but the rising [[tide]] gave him no time to hesitate. He had to [[tidy]] the cargo area and [[tie]] every crate [[tight]].

A caged [[tiger]] shook the deck. Sailors would [[tighten]] its ropes and bind them [[tightly]] while a roof [[tile]] began to [[tilt]]. A [[tiny]] [[tin]] box held the [[timely]] warning: the [[timber]] shipment’s [[timetable]] had been altered. A forgotten [[tip]] from a porter confirmed sabotage.

The work could [[tire]] anyone, but the [[tiresome]] checks prevented disaster. A splinter damaged the clerk’s hand [[tissue]], yet he copied the owner’s [[title]] from the document and alerted the harbor. [[thus|Thus]], a delayed voyage saved every sailor, and the clerk learned that courage could speak in a quiet voice.

title: 蟾蜍旅馆的地下收费站
cn: 旅客入住蟾蜍旅馆，发现早餐有烟草味、台阶破损，厕所竟需信物与高额通行费。
老板口称宽容，却威胁提问者。旅客沿寒冷通道走到墓室，发现大车堵住入口，里面有人说话。
他从顶部开口进入，救出被折磨的商人。火把照见失窃鱼雷和工具，洪水暴露的地窖成为证据，宠物龟也获自由。
en: A traveler named the inn after a [[toad]] on its sign. At breakfast, [[toast]] smelled of [[tobacco]], and a broken step hurt his [[toe]]. The advertised [[toilet]] was locked behind a gate that required a [[token]] and a heavy [[toll]].

The owner preached [[tolerance]] but was not [[tolerant]] of questions. The guest refused to [[tolerate]] the charge. He put down his [[tomato]] and followed a cold passage toward a [[tomb]]. A cart weighing a [[ton]] blocked its entrance; a voice spoke in a threatening [[tone]] and an unfamiliar [[tongue]].

Using a simple [[tool]], he opened the [[top]] hatch. The real [[topic]] was a captive merchant whom the owner tried to [[torment]]. A [[torch]] revealed stolen naval parts: a [[torpedo]], a [[torque]] wrench, and plans for river defenses. A [[torrent]] had exposed the cellar, and the guest freed the merchant. Even the inn’s pet [[tortoise]] escaped its dirty cage.

cn: 囚徒遭绑匪折磨，赎金令人绝望。孩子触碰桌上的玩具车，发现其中暗藏代码。
向导假装参观仓库，沿着湿毛巾遮盖的有毒泄漏痕迹追查，穿过拖拉机耕作的大片土地。
代码指出伪商标和贸易路线。商贩借传统节庆堵车掩盖绑架，向导及时救出囚徒，避免悲剧。

A [[tough]] guide took a supposed [[tour]] toward the warehouse. A truck had to [[tow]] the broken van [[towards]] the gate while the guide moved [[toward]] a [[tower]]. A wet [[towel]] concealed a [[toxic]] spill. Its [[track]] crossed a [[tract]] of land worked by a [[tractor]].

The code named a [[trade]] route and a forged [[trademark]]. A [[trader]] had bribed a [[tradesman]] to alter the crates. Under a [[traditional]] festival [[tradition]], [[traffic]] stalled, hiding the kidnapping. The guide followed the [[trail]] before a [[tragic]] outcome turned into a [[tragedy]], rescued the prisoner, and returned the child’s toy.

cn: 冷静学者参加风谷救援训练，叛徒践踏她的笔记，流浪者却帮她拾回。她克服恐惧继续任务。
队伍要运送损坏变压器，雷雨导致信号传输失败。铁路转船的路线必须靠清晰古地图指示。
学者正确翻译透明桥的记载，揭穿叛徒所谓心脏移植的解释。队伍穿越横梁，把补给安全运到村庄。
en: A [[tranquil]] scholar joined rescue [[training]] beside a [[tram]] line. Her strongest [[trait]] was patience, but a [[traitor]] tried to [[trample]] her notes. A wandering [[tramp]] recovered them and helped her [[transcend]] her fear.

The team needed to [[transfer]] a damaged [[transformer]]. Its [[transformation]] of current failed during a [[transient]] storm. A broken [[transistor]] blocked a signal they must [[transmit]]. The [[transit]] route’s [[transition]] from rail to boat depended on clear instructions.

The scholar could [[translate]] the ancient map. Her [[translation]] described a [[transparent]] bridge, not a living heart [[transplant]] as the traitor claimed. They arranged safe [[transport]] and reliable [[transportation]], then crossed a [[transverse]] beam to [[traverse]] the valley. His [[trap]] collapsed into [[trash]]. Their supplies arrived on a bamboo [[tray]], and the rescued village welcomed the scholar.

title: 三角部落的第四次审判
cn: 部落向帝国财务官缴纳贡物，他却侵吞宝藏并指控抗议者叛国。证人受伤发抖，医师先照护再作证。
三角封印确认宝箱归属，财务官却称此事微不足道，还设置焚毁账册的机关。其他城镇受害者陆续赶来。
证人穿过沟槽剪断引线，揭露三倍征收。宝藏由推车送回，财务官被军队押走，部落获得公正。
en: A [[tribe]] paid [[tribute]] to an imperial [[treasurer]], who stole their [[treasure]] and called protest [[treason]]. During the [[trial]], a witness began to [[tremble]]. Guards ordered him to [[tread]] carefully, though a [[treaty]] guaranteed fair [[treatment]].

A healer would [[treat]] his wounds before testimony. A [[triangular]] seal formed a [[triangle]] on the stolen chest. The treasurer’s [[trick]] was to call it a [[trifle]], but a hidden [[trigger]] could burn the records. A [[tremendous]] crowd had grown [[tremendously]], following the [[trend]] of similar thefts from towns.

The witness crawled through a [[trench]] to [[trim]] the fuse. His evidence showed [[triple]] charges on every tribute. Such sums were never [[trivial]]. He earned no [[triumphant]] parade, but the court’s judgment was a [[triumph]]. A [[trolley]] returned the treasure, and the emperor’s [[troop]] escorted the thief to prison.

title: 黄昏隧道的双胞胎
cn: 黄昏时，住在热带河岸的双胞胎追着号声跑向货车。免收学费的老师担心他们。
司机隐藏了治疗结核的药物，树干、浴盆与管道拼成隧道线索。孩子把地图塞进外套，准备找拖船求助。
老师赶来稳定局面，在金枪鱼与蔬菜货箱之间找回药品封印。司机在下个弯道被捕，河镇恢复生机，孩子种下郁金香。
en: A [[tutor]] waived [[tuition]] for two children. Each [[twin]] lived near a [[tropical]] river on the [[tropic]] line. In [[twilight]], they heard a [[trumpet]] and began to [[trot]] after a [[truck]], pulling at their muddy [[trousers]].

A [[troublesome]] driver claimed they could not [[truly]] [[trust]] him. The [[truth]] was in a hollow tree [[trunk]]: stolen medicine for [[tuberculosis]]. A [[tube]] hidden in a [[tub]] led to a [[tunnel]]. The twins would [[tuck]] the map inside a coat and seek a harbor [[tug]].

A [[turbine]] stirred [[turbulent]] water, but the tutor calmed the [[turmoil]]. She recovered the map before it could [[tumble]] into the river. Among crates of [[tuna]], [[turkey]], and [[turnip|turnips]], a [[turtle]] hid the medicine seal. At the next [[turning]], the driver was caught. The town’s [[turnover]] grew again, children planted a [[tulip]], and the tutor played a gentle [[tune]] beneath stars that began to [[twinkle]].

title: 台风中的打字员
cn: 暴君在台风中威胁打字员，机器色带扭结使投诉证据难以辨认。她用探测器和紫外光恢复删字。
卡车轮胎损坏，她无法赶到避难所。救援队一致同意改用小车，带她穿过寒冷风雨。
昏迷守卫也得到照料。大学生提出打开地板保险箱的特别办法，众人小心行动，最终把投诉带到法庭。
en: A [[typist]] heard an [[ugly]] threat from a [[tyrant]]. His [[tyranny]] had reached its [[ultimate]] test during a [[typhoon]]. The office [[typewriter]] could record every [[type]] of complaint, but a [[twist]] in the ribbon made the evidence hard to read.

The clerk used an [[ultrasonic]] detector and [[ultraviolet]] light to reveal erased letters. She carried an [[umbrella]] to the shelter, yet a broken truck [[tyre]] left her [[unable]] to travel. A [[unanimous]] group of rescuers called the delay [[unavoidable]] and brought a cart.

The cold was [[unbearable]], the future [[uncertain]], and the road [[uncomfortable]]. An [[unconscious]] guard required help. An [[undergraduate]] proposed an [[unconventional]] way to [[uncover]] the tyrant’s safe beneath the floor. They would not [[underestimate]] the storm or make anyone [[undergo]] danger alone. The complaints were [[ultimately]] read in court; the rescue showed [[typical]] village courage.

title: 地下城的统一制服
cn: 地下城议会想统一各区，却压下漏水报告。工程师从喷泉下面找到裂口，先询问工人的处境。
失业与不均工资使大家不安。工程师坚持公平报酬，拒绝用统一制服掩饰不合理条件。
突发漏水淹没卧房，她公布跨区工队计划，让各维修单位结成联盟。工人共同修复喷泉，也恢复了团结。
en: An [[underground]] city’s council wanted to [[unify]] every district. Leaders should [[underline]] its [[underlying]] water problems, yet chose to [[undermine]] the reports. [[underneath|Underneath]] an old fountain, an [[unknown]] engineer found the leak.

She sought [[understanding]] before agreeing to [[undertake]] the repair. The [[undertaking]] required fair pay, even for workers whose only dry clothes were [[underwear]]. [[unemployment|Unemployment]] had left them [[uneasy]], and an [[uneven]] wage policy was [[unfair]]. [[undoubtedly|Undoubtedly]], calling them [[unfit]] would be [[unjust]] and [[unkind]].

The council issued a [[uniform]] but could not solve [[undesirable]] conditions [[uniformly]]. The engineer began to [[unfold]] a [[unique]] plan: [[unite]] each repair [[unit]] in a workers’ [[union]]. An [[unexpected]] leak seemed [[unfortunate]]; [[unfortunately]], it flooded a bedroom. Yet [[unity]] could [[undo]] the damage. The formerly [[unhappy]] workers repaired the fountain together.

title: 没有尽头的大学门
cn: 大学宣传免费开放知识，门卫却向搬书访客收费并锁住大厅。馆员怀疑此举没有合法依据。
搬运工遭欠薪又被指责失职，建筑电线也不稳。馆员指出门卫账目和服务问题，坚持查验合同。
拆开的箱子明确标示捐赠图书，最新合同及另存文件也写着免费开放。更新安保后，大门终于向公众打开。
en: A [[university]] advertised [[universal]] knowledge of the [[universe]], promising its books were [[universally]] free. A guard would [[unload]] boxes [[unless]] visitors paid a fee, and he refused to [[unlock]] the hall. [[unlike|Unlike]] him, the librarian doubted the fee; [[unlimited]] authority seemed [[unlikely]] to be legal.

An [[unlucky]] visitor found the guard’s [[unnecessary]] rules [[unreasonable]]. His [[unorthodox]] bookkeeping was [[unreliable]], his service [[unsatisfactory]], and the hall’s wiring [[unstable]]. An [[unpaid]] porter was blamed for the [[unpleasant]] conditions. The librarian called the demands [[unprecedented]] and the guard [[unsuitable]] for the post.

She asked him to [[untie]] the boxes. Their [[unusual]] labels were [[unusually]] clear: donated books, with no price. Though [[unwilling]], he revealed an [[up-to-date]] contract. An [[update]] and a security [[upgrade]] would [[uphold]] the free-access promise. A second file named “[[uptodate]]” had the same terms. The doors opened at last.

cn: 城市检查员上阁楼，发现倒装架子上的瓶子，气流把灰尘吹向楼上。主人声称度假时瓶子失踪。
瓶上标着铀，家人恐慌。检查员安抚众人并查看器具使用记录，发现瓶内其实是真空，用来测试室内空气。
阀门测试证明主人藏瓶推销不实洁净承诺。她责令修缮环境，并为附近传播的疾病安排儿童接种。

The household’s [[uproar]] had made the owner [[upset]]. He claimed he was on [[vacation]] when the bottle disappeared. Its label named [[uranium]], but the inspector would [[urge]] calm during the [[urgent]] inquiry. A log of its [[usage]] listed every [[user]] and every [[used]] [[utensil]].

The bottle held a [[vacuum]], not dangerous powder. Its [[utility]] was to test household air, and its [[utilization]] required a pump. The inspector could [[utilize]] a [[useful]] valve; the owner’s map was [[useless]]. With the [[utmost]] care, she checked the [[usual]] records and made him [[utter]] the truth. He had hidden the bottle to sell a [[utopian]] promise of perfectly clean rooms; she ordered repairs and arranged to [[vaccinate]] the children against a spreading illness.

货车在密林金库旁受蒸汽阀阻挡，不断变化的风速使植物受损。管理员检查通风情况。
花瓶天鹅绒包裹内的向量图与堵塞通风口的钻具揭露盗掘。石脉和钻尘相符，工人恢复通风后将花瓶归还神龛。

title: 老兵的金星诗
cn: 老兵准备出城观金星，写了一首诗。议会围绕传统与新译本争执，差点酿成暴力。
墙振动露出驶离船上的箱子，穿背心的守卫否决检查，企图拖延到船经运河逃走。
箱内是老兵被盗勋章，守卫赌博欠债，债主就在附近。船员及时拦截，诗人把胜利归于诚实言语。
en: A [[veteran]] planned to [[venture]] beyond the city to watch [[venus|Venus]]. His poem used a [[verb]] differently in each [[verse]]. A [[verbal]] argument over its [[version]] stood on the [[verge]] of violence: the council debated tradition [[versus]] a [[versatile]] new translation.

An old [[vertical]] banner shook as the walls began to [[vibrate]]. Its [[vibration]] exposed a chest on a departing [[vessel]]. A guard in a [[vest]] tried to [[veto]] an inspection. He thought he could [[vex]] the poet until the boat escaped [[via]] the canal.

The poet saw his stolen medals in the chest. The guard’s [[vice]] was gambling; his [[vicious]] collector waited in the [[vicinity]]. The poet refused to become another [[victim]] they could [[victimize]]. His shipmates secured the chest, and the council celebrated a [[victorious]] return. The poet called it a quiet [[victory]] for honest words.

title: 紫罗兰别墅的录像
cn: 别墅访客发现一盒录像带，画面与主人对昨夜的说法不一致。园丁显得特别用力工作。
画面中他往紫罗兰布上倒醋，主人说他违规。原始录像却显示守卫暴力摇晃园丁，因为他发现珠宝失踪。
未动过的土块下藏着珠宝。虚拟参观被病毒遮蔽，签证又证明园丁到达日期。访客凭原带揭露守卫谎言。
en: A [[visitor]] at a [[villa]] found a [[videotape]] beside a [[vine]]. The [[video]] challenged the owner’s [[view]] of the previous night. From her [[viewpoint]], a [[vigorous]] gardener had worked with unusual [[vigor]]; his note spelled the word “[[vigour]].”

Footage showed him pouring [[vinegar]] on a [[violet]] cloth. The owner claimed he had tried to [[violate]] the property rules. Yet the real [[violation]] was [[violence]] by a [[violent]] guard, who shook the gardener [[violently]] after he found missing jewels.

A [[virgin]] patch of ground concealed the jewels under an untouched stone. A [[virtual]] tour was [[virtually]] useless because a computer [[virus]] had obscured the view. The gardener’s travel [[visa]] provided his true arrival date. The visitor felt a [[visceral]] anger at the guard’s lies, then used the original tape to clear the gardener.

title: 火山口的词汇课
cn: 职业语言教师带学生在火山附近培训，用可视地图想象逃生路线。烟灰将很快降低能见度。
警报装置漏出黏液，电压变化使音量降低。老师用清晰语音和生动描述传达危险，帮助学生掌握新词。
志愿者放下排球协助转移，大家投票决定乘船。学生带好维生素和水，照顾脆弱儿童，避开火山口。
en: A [[vocal]] teacher treated language as her [[vocation]]. During [[vocational]] training near a [[volcano]], she asked students to [[visualize]] danger through [[visual]] maps. Good [[visibility]] made each escape route [[visible]], but ash could obscure their [[vision]].

A [[viscous]] liquid leaked from the alarm. Power dropped: a single [[volt]] of lost [[voltage]] affected the signal [[volume]]. The teacher’s [[voice]] filled the hall, explaining each [[vowel]] clearly. Her [[vivid]] description made the danger [[vividly]] real, expanding their [[vocabulary]].

Health was [[vital]], and [[vitality]] depended [[vitally]] on air and water. The class packed a [[vitamin]] supply; an old label read “[[vitamine]].” A [[voluntary]] [[volunteer]] abandoned a [[volleyball]] game to help. A [[vote]] approved evacuation by boat. Nobody would cross the crater’s [[void]] on that [[voyage]], and no [[vulgar]] joke distracted them from the [[vulnerable]] children.

title: 货栈里的核桃钱包
cn: 服务员与女服务员讨薪，被老板叫去淹水货栈。狗在旧货车旁摇尾，仓门紧锁。
他们唤醒守卫，发现腰边钱包和核桃，钱包钥匙能开藏着赃物的衣柜。守卫曾受命在搬货时外出。
两人先送发烧守卫就医，得到他的证词后报警。搜查令使货栈被查封，老板补发工资，守卫出庭作证。
en: A [[waiter]] and a [[waitress]] went to collect their unpaid [[wage]]. The employer told them to [[wade]] through the flood to a [[warehouse]]. A dog began to [[wag]] its tail beside a [[wagon]]; the old sign used the spelling “[[waggon]].”

The workers tried to [[waken]] the sleeping guard. A [[wallet]] lay at his [[waist]] beside a [[walnut]]. Inside, a key opened a [[wardrobe]] stocked with stolen [[ware]]. The guard had agreed to [[wander]] outside whenever the employer moved valuables.

The workers refused another private [[war]]. They cared for the feverish guard in a hospital [[ward]] and gave him [[warmth]]. His account of the employer’s little financial [[warfare]] led them to [[warn]] investigators. A written [[warning]] and a valid [[warrant]] secured the warehouse. The employer paid both workers, and the guard testified.

title: 瀑布边的蜡封婚书
cn: 新娘在瀑布边等婚书。防水袋完整，墨迹却被水弄淡，她拒绝随意丢弃证据。
无线电波长记录与破蜡封揭示新郎的假故事。他伪造富叔叔的财产承诺，借口越来越无力。
织工帮助新娘核查，箱缝杂草指明新郎走过的路径，仪式武器又留下切痕。新娘延期婚礼，保存真实婚书。
en: A [[watchful]] bride waited by a [[waterfall]]. A [[wasp]] circled the [[waterproof]] bag containing her [[wedding]] letter. The bag was [[watertight]], but [[watery]] ink suggested someone had opened it. Her groom called the ruined page a [[waste]], though discarding it would be [[wasteful]].

A meter marked one [[watt]] beside a radio. Its [[wave]] changed [[wavelength]], making the groom [[waver]] in his story. A broken [[wax]] seal exposed his [[weakness]]: he had forged a promise of [[wealth]] from a [[wealthy]] uncle. His [[weak]] excuse could only [[weaken]] trust.

A [[weaver]] helped the [[weary]] bride [[weigh]] the evidence. She would [[weave]] a new cover, use a [[wedge]] to open the box, and remove a tangled [[web]]. A [[weed]] stuck to its hinge traced the groom’s route. He had used a ceremonial [[weapon]] to cut the seal. The bride postponed the wedding and kept the truthful letter.

title: 西码头的每周小提琴
cn: 寡妇每周工作日在西码头拉小提琴，为福利机构募款。热心船长前来听琴，却发现她听到怪声后哭起来。
粮车刚焊过的轮子发出哨音，粮袋印着鲸向西游的图案。寡妇认出焊工袖子上的破口。
窃贼用音乐向同伙发偷粮信号，哨音却暴露了逃船。寡妇奏最后一个音时，守卫在码头抓住了他。
en: A [[widow]] played the [[violin]] at the [[wharf]] every [[weekday]]. Her [[weekly]] concerts funded local [[welfare]]. A [[well-known]] captain listened with [[sympathy]], believing kindness a [[virtue]]. Yet one night she began to [[weep]] at a [[weird]] sound beneath the music.

Workers had to [[weld]] a broken [[wheel]] on a grain cart. A sack of [[wheat]] carried a drawing of a [[whale]] heading [[westward]]. [[whenever|Whenever]] the wheel turned, it produced a [[whistle]], [[whereas]] the captain’s boat normally stayed silent. The widow touched a torn [[sleeve]] and began to [[stare]] at the supposed welder.

The captain would investigate [[whatever]] the danger, accepting no false account [[whatsoever]]. The thief’s [[scheme]] used music as a signal [[whereby]] an accomplice could steal grain. He could escape [[wherever]] he chose, but [[whichever]] boat he took, the widow recognized the whistle. [[whilst|Whilst]] she played the final note, guards seized the thief at the dock.

cn: 柳树下的风车在大风天停转，猫的胡须也被烧焦。拿鞭守卫试图让围观者闭嘴。
守卫酒后损坏磨坊，上司却把事故洗成任性小错，谎言广传。磨坊主测量轴宽，扩大调查。
村民需要健康面粉，不能靠掩饰维持生计。受损鸟翼证实爆炸，守卫认错，磨坊主诚实修好风车，赢得村赛。
en: A [[willing]] miller watched a [[whirl]] of leaves beneath the [[willow]]. His [[windmill]] stopped on a [[windy]] day. Along the [[winding]] path stood a [[wild]] cat with a singed [[whisker]]. A guard carrying a [[whip]] tried to hush the crowd with a [[whisper]].

The guard had drunk [[whisky]] and [[wine]], then damaged the mill. His boss sought to [[whitewash]] the accident, calling him merely [[wilful]]; an altered report used “[[willful]].” A [[widespread]] lie spread [[widely]]. The miller measured the broken axle’s [[width]] and would [[widen]] the inquiry.

The [[whole]] village deserved [[wholesome]] flour. It was [[wholly]] [[wicked]] to hide the damage, [[whoever]] paid for it. The miller would [[wield]] no weapon, yet expected truth to [[win]]. The guard gave a nervous [[wink]], but a pigeon’s damaged [[wing]] proved the blast. The miller became the village contest’s [[winner]] after repairing the mill honestly.

title: 无线电里的狼与啄木鸟
cn: 森林管理员修好无线电线，试图保护中了毒的动物。猎人却隐瞒受伤狼的地点，不肯撤回毒饵。
孩子从啄木鸟的敲击声听出规律，猜到工坊里有被困鸟。管理员带工人进门检查。
羊毛围巾裹着伤鸟，钻孔工件里藏着准备全球出售的农药。管理员救回鸟与狼，阻止货物外运，土地恢复安全。
en: A [[wise]] keeper used [[wireless]] signals to protect a forest. A torn [[wire]] hung beneath [[wood]] branches; he would [[wipe]] its contacts and listen [[within]] the hut. His [[wisdom]] was practical, and his [[wit]] made frightened children smile.

A hunter began to [[withhold]] news of a wounded [[wolf]]. Plants would [[wither]] if the hunter’s poison spread, yet he refused to [[withdraw]]. A [[witty]] child heard a [[woodpecker]] tapping the [[wooden]] roof. The strange rhythm made her [[wonder]] whether a captive was calling. It was a [[wonderful]] clue amid their [[woe]].

Inside the hunter’s [[workshop]], a [[workman]] found a trapped bird wrapped in [[wool]] and a [[woollen]] scarf. A drilled [[workpiece]] hid pesticide meant for a [[worldwide]] sale; the label read “[[world-wide]].” The keeper freed the bird, treated the wolf, and stopped the shipment. A rescued [[worm]] wriggled back into unpoisoned soil.

title: 花圈下的破船与手腕
cn: 作家在葬礼花圈旁遇到受伤海员，腕上新旧伤痕交错。他写下灯塔外沉船的位置，官员却称报告毫无价值。
最严重风暴到来，船长不肯救援，还愤怒地推搡海员。作家坚持每个人都值得被救。
她用扳手开门，包扎伤手并帮助救援。便携透视检查发现船长藏匿的赃货，货单复印件和获救海员证词一起送进法庭。
en: A [[writer]] found a [[wretched]] sailor beneath a funeral [[wreath]]. The sailor’s [[wrist]] held a [[wrinkle]] of scar tissue; a fresh [[wound]] lay above it. His [[writing]] described a [[wreck]] hidden beyond a lighthouse, but officials called the report [[worthless]].

The night became [[worse]], then the season’s [[worst]] storm arrived. A captain claimed rescue was not [[worthwhile]], though the sailor said every life was [[worthy]] of care. He refused to [[worship]] the captain’s authority. In sudden [[wrath]], the captain tried to [[wrestle]] him aside.

The writer used a [[wrench]] to release a door and helped [[wrap]] the sailor’s hand. They would [[wring]] water from blankets while rescuers searched the [[wreckage]]. A portable [[x-ray]] revealed the captain’s hidden stolen cargo. The writer made a [[xerox]] copy of the cargo list and delivered it to court. The rescued sailors lived to give their own accounts.

title: 斑马区的青年酵母实验
cn: 少年在港口院子里热心工作，积攒一年工资想买小艇。青年社团请他帮忙做面包实验。
斑马围场附近的酵母面团正在发起，他检查炉上轭架并分离蛋黄，尽量不惊动动物。
少年发现锌管腐蚀漏进食品区，及时停水、转移面团。他拿买船积蓄购置干净管件，青年社团随后募款偿还。
en: A [[youthful]] [[youngster]] worked with [[zeal]] in the harbor [[yard]]. He saved his [[yearly]] wages for a small [[yacht]], though tiredness made him [[yawn]]. The harbor’s [[youth]] club hoped he would [[yearn]] for learning as much as sailing.

A [[zealous]] baker asked him to test [[yeast]] near a [[zebra]] enclosure. One bowl could [[yield]] enough bread for a feast. Its [[yielding]] dough grew warm; the boy checked a cracked [[yoke]] above the oven and separated an egg’s [[yolk]]. The baker warned him not to [[yell]] and alarm the animals.

A corroded [[zinc]] pipe leaked into the food area of this [[zone]]. The boy noticed it before anyone ate. He shut the water off, moved the dough to safety, and helped repair the pipe. His yacht fund bought clean fittings; the youth club later raised the money to repay him.
